Help Center Scheduling Messages

Scheduling Messages

19 articles

Everything about one-time scheduling: the basic flow, every content type the bot can post, and the tools to manage what you have queued.

The basic flow
1. Tap Schedule Message (or send /schedule).
2. Pick the channel — the bot you paired with it will do the posting.
3. Enter the date and time: use the format DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM (for example 25.12.2025 10:00) or send it in the same message as the text.
4. Send the message content — plain text or with photos, videos, documents, polls, stickers, voice, locations.
5. Review the preview and confirm.

The post goes out automatically at the chosen time, in the channel's time zone. Before scheduling works at all, two things must be connected: the channel (bot as admin) and its sender bot — see Getting Started if you are not there yet.

Managing the queue
Everything you schedule lands in the Message List and Calendar: preview before it posts, edit any detail, or delete what changed. The topics below cover each content type and every management tool.

How many channels can I connect?

Common questions

Do I need a sender bot?

Yes - every channel needs its own sender bot to post. Connect one from Bots right after connecting a channel. Sender bots give you your brand name on posts, faster delivery, better security, and per-channel statistics.

How do I create a sender bot?

1. Open @BotFather in Telegram
2. Send /newbot
3. Choose a name and username
4. Copy the token
5. Add the bot as admin in your channel
6. Send the token to Fast Scheduler Bot

Help Center Admins

Admins

4 articles

The Admins section manages who can use a connected channel and what they can do. It lives inside Sender Bots Management → Admins and is available to every channel that has at least one admin.

All articles

4 articles
Overview: AdminsStart hereHow Admins Share LimitsGuidePermissions & RequestsGuideOwnership TransferGuide

Common questions

How do I become an admin of a channel?

Anyone who is a real human administrator with the Post Messages permission in your channel can be listed as an admin. The list is synced live from Telegram — connect a channel and the bot discovers its admins automatically.

Only the Main Owner (the channel creator) can manage the Admins section and change permissions. Other admins can use the features they've been granted.

Permissions & RequestsChannel Permissions
What happens if another admin of my channel activates Premium?

Premium is per channel: when any admin of a channel activates Premium, that channel's limits upgrade for everyone who uses it — other channels you have stay on their own limits.

The upgrade is automatic and needs no action from the other admins.

How Admins Share LimitsPremium
How do I request a permission I don't have?

If you tap a button you don't have access to, the bot shows "You do not have permission…" with a Request permission from the admin button underneath.

Press it, optionally add a short message explaining why you need the permission, and the Main Owner gets a Yes/No request. One request per permission per week, so think about what you ask for!

Permissions & RequestsOwnership Transfer
Do multiple admins get separate limits?

Yes — that's the whole point of the system. Every admin of the same channel shares the exact same quota: the monthly scheduled limit counts how many messages were scheduled this calendar month across all admins, and it never goes back down when messages are sent. Once the month's quota is spent, no admin can schedule more until next month (or until Premium is active for that channel).

How Admins Share LimitsLimits

Common questions

How do I purchase Premium?

Step by step:
1. Click Premium on the main menu (or use /premium)
2. Choose a plan: Monthly (auto-renewing), 3-month, 6-month, or Yearly (prepaid, one-time)
3. Select payment method: Telegram Stars (in-app purchase)
4. Follow the payment provider's instructions
5. Premium activates immediately after confirmation

If not active after 5 min, see Premium Troubleshooting sub-topic.

Premium Troubleshooting
How do I cancel my Premium auto-renewal?

Step by step:
1. Click Premium on the main menu (or use /premium)
2. Click ❌ Cancel Premium
3. Select a reason (optional) → confirm with ✅ Yes, Cancel Premium
4. Your Premium stays active until the paid period ends
(Cancel applies to the auto-renewing monthly plan; prepaid 3/6-month and yearly plans never auto-renew.)
5. Changed your mind before it ends? Open Premium again and buy a plan — you are Premium again instantly.

What happens when Premium expires (full timeline)?

Here is how the Premium expiry process works — from the moment your subscription ends to the final cleanup. Nothing is deleted in the first days; you have time to choose what to keep.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Before Expiry — What to Expect
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• You will receive a notification a few days before your Premium ends
• If auto-renew is on and the payment succeeds, nothing changes — you stay Premium
• If payment fails or you cancel, the expiry timeline below begins on the last day of your paid period

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Day 0 — Notification & Choose What to Keep
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• You receive a detailed notification with the Choose What to Keep interactive menu
• You select which channels, sender bots, recurring messages, and media storage boxes to keep within Free plan limits
• How choosing works: each item has a toggle button — tap to mark Keep or Remove. Selecting a channel auto-selects its sender bot. When you finish, tap Save Selection
• If you don't choose: the system keeps the most recent channel, its bot, the newest recurring message, and the newest media storage box automatically

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Days 1-2 — Grace Period
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Everything works normally — all messages send to all channels
• You can still change your keep choices if you want

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Day 3 — First Warning
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Notification: "Messages will stop tomorrow"
• All messages still sent today
• Media deletion warning if you haven't picked a storage box to keep

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Day 4 — Messages to Excess Channels Stop
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Messages to non-kept channels stop being sent
• Kept channels continue normally — no disruption for what you chose to keep
• Signatures are stripped from all sent messages (signatures are a Premium feature)
• You get a prompt to download a full backup of your data as an importable .fsback file
• What happens to non-chosen items: they are frozen (not deleted). Their scheduled messages are skipped but preserved. You can still export them

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Days 14-15 — Mid-Wait Notices
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Day 14: "Disconnect in 3 weeks" notice
• Day 15: Mid-wait reminder

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Day 17 — Media Cleanup
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Non-kept media storages are permanently deleted
• Your kept storage is trimmed to the newest 100 items (videos are removed first)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Day 35 + 12 Hours — Final Disconnect
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• 12-hour warning on day 35
• After 12 hours: excess channels are disconnected, excess sender bot tokens are removed
• All signatures are permanently deleted
• Your account is now fully on the Free plan

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
How to Reactivate
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
At any point before the final disconnect: use /premium or click Premium → choose a plan → pay. Everything restores instantly — channels, bots, messages, and media.

After final disconnect, you can still re-subscribe but need to reconnect channels manually.

See also: Item Freezing and Premium Expiry topics below for more details.

Premium ExpiryFrozen Assets
How do I choose which channels to keep on expiry?

On day 0 after expiry, you get an interactive Choose What to Keep menu. Each channel, sender bot, and recurring message has a toggle button — tap to mark Keep or Remove.

How it works:
• Selecting a channel auto-selects its assigned sender bot
• You can only keep as many items as the Free plan allows (e.g., 1 channel, 1 bot, 1 recurring message)
• Once done, tap Save Selection
• Then you choose a media storage box to keep (you can keep 1 box)

If you don't choose: the system auto-selects the most recent channel, its bot, the newest recurring message, and the newest media storage box.

See Item Freezing below for what happens to items you don't select.

Frozen Assets
Will my media be deleted when Premium expires?

Media you choose to keep is safe. On day 0 you pick 1 storage to keep. Day 3 is a final warning. Day 17: excess storages are permanently deleted. Your kept storage is trimmed to the newest 100 items (videos are removed first, oldest first). To keep everything: renew Premium with /premium before day 17.

Premium ExpiryFrozen Assets
What is Signatures and how do I use it?

Add a signature once and every post in that channel carries it: send /signature (or tap 📝 Signature on the review screen), pick the channel, and send the text. Manage or remove it any time from the same menu.

Signatures (Premium)
How do I earn free Premium days?

Use the Referral Program to invite friends, or redeem a Promo Code.

ReferralsPromo Codes

Help Center Limits

Limits

16 articles

Fast Scheduler's plans differ in five numbers: pending scheduled messages, sends per month, recurring messages, channels, and sender bots. The bot counts them live — /stats always shows your current usage.

  • Free: 100 pending messages, 100 sends per channel per month, 1 recurring message, 1 channel, 1 sender bot.
  • Premium: unlimited pending and sent messages, unlimited recurring messages, 3 channels, 3 bots, plus larger media storage and longer videos.

There is no daily cap on either plan — the only send quota on Free is monthly, and it resets on the 1st.

Common questions

How do I disable language sync?

Go to Language on the main menu → tap Disable Language Sync. This stops cross-bot sync offers between Fast Scheduler and @SetDate_bot, and turns off Telegram language detection. You can re-enable it anytime from the same menu.

How do I hide language sync notifications?

Premium feature. Go to Language on the main menu → tap Hide Notifications. Sync still works but you won't see the notification popups. Toggle it back to show notifications again.

Common questions

Can I import messages in bulk?

Yes! Send a .txt file where each message is separated by a blank line. All messages will be imported with the same date/time. You can then edit each one individually.

What formats are supported for import?

Supported formats: .txt, .csv, .json, .rtf, .odt, .fsback (full backup), .fspback (password-protected backup).

Overview: BackupStart hereCreate BackupGuideWhat Is Backed UpGuideWhat Is ExcludedGuideBackup PasswordGuideBackup SizeGuideScheduled BackupsGuideRestore BackupGuideVerifyGuideCloudGuideDownloadGuideWhat Is the Difference Between .fsback and .fspback?4 Q&AHow to Back Up All Scheduled Posts in Telegram (and Restore Them Anywhere)4 Q&A

Common questions

How do I export my data?

Step by step:
1. Click Export on the main menu (page 2) or use /export
2. Choose what to export: Scheduled Messages, Recurring Messages, or Media Storage
3. Choose format:
• .txt — plain text, human-readable
• .csv — spreadsheet (opens in Excel/Google Sheets)
• .json — structured data for developers
4. The file is sent to you as a document

For a full backup (Premium): use /backup → choose password protection (optional) → the .fsback file is sent to you. To restore: use /import and send the .fsback file.

How do I restore a backup?

Step by step:
1. Click Import on the main menu (page 2) or use /import
2. Send the backup file (.fsback or .fspback)
3. If password-protected, enter the password when prompted
4. The bot restores all your data — messages, channels, bots, settings
5. You'll get a confirmation when done

Note: Restoring a backup replaces your current data. Make sure to export your current data first if you want to keep it.

Can I set up automatic backups?

Automatic backups are not available as a built-in feature yet. However, you can manually export anytime:
• Use /export for selective export (scheduled, recurring, or media)
• Use /backup for a full backup (Premium, can be password-protected)

Recommendation: export your data regularly, especially before making big changes.

How do I create a password-protected backup?

Premium feature. Step by step:
1. Use /backup command
2. When prompted, choose Enable Password Protection
3. Enter a password (you'll need this to restore later — don't forget it!)
4. The .fspback file is generated and sent to you
5. To restore: use /import → send the .fspback file → enter the password

Warning: Without the password, the backup cannot be restored. Keep your password safe!

What's included in a full backup?

A full backup (.fsback / .fspback) includes: all scheduled messages (text, media, settings), all recurring messages, media storage items and boxes, channel connections and settings, bot tokens and assignments, user preferences (language, timezone), and referral data. Everything needed to restore your account to exactly the same state.

What's the difference between .fsback and .fspback?

.fsback is a standard full backup (no password). .fspback is a password-protected backup with encryption (Premium only). Both contain the same data, but .fspback requires a password to restore. To create a .fspback: use /backup → choose password protection → enter your password.

Overview: Media StorageStart hereWhen to Use Storage1 Q&AStorage Boxes1 Q&ACreate a BoxGuideRename BoxGuideArchiveGuideQuotaGuidePreviewGuideManage BoxGuideSave MediaGuideManage StorageGuideStorage LimitsGuideStorage on PremiumGuideMedia Compression & Retention3 Q&ALifecycle1 Q&ABulk Move, Copy & Box Download3 Q&AWhat Is Media Storage and How Do You Use It Without Losing Your Mind?2 Q&A

Common questions

How do I create a storage box and save media?

Step by step:
1. Click Media Storage on the main menu (page 2) or use /storage
2. Click Create Box
3. Enter a name for your box (e.g., "Product Photos")
4. The box is created — now click on it to open it
5. Send photos, videos, or files to the bot — they'll be saved in this box
6. Later, when scheduling a message, choose From Storage as the media option and pick from your collection

Free plan: 1 box, max 100 items, no videos. Premium: up to 20 boxes, 500 items.

How do I rename or delete a storage box?

To rename: click Media Storage → select the box → click Rename → type the new name → confirm.

To delete: click Media Storage → select the box → click Delete Box → confirm deletion. Warning: Deleting a box removes ALL media inside it permanently.

Can I move items between storage boxes?

Yes — bulk move and copy is a Premium feature. Step by step:
1. Click Media Storage → open the source box
2. Use Move All or Copy All (optionally filtered by type: images, videos, files)
3. Choose the destination box from the list
4. The items are moved/copied — no need to re-upload

On the Free plan you can move or copy one file at a time instead — open the item and use Move / Copy.

This helps you reorganize your media collection without re-uploading anything.

Can I download a whole storage box?

Yes — box download is a Premium feature: open the box and tap Download Box to get its files as an archive.

On the Free plan open any item and tap Download to save files one at a time, without compression.

What happens to my storage when Premium expires?

On the first day after expiry, you'll get a prompt to choose 1 storage box to keep. If you don't choose, the newest box is kept by default. Excess boxes are deleted after 17 days. The kept box is trimmed to the newest 100 items (videos are removed first, oldest first). To avoid this: reactivate Premium with /premium before day 17.

Premium ExpiryFrozen Assets
Can I store videos in Media Storage?

Free plan: No in storage — you'll get an error if you try. Premium: up to 50MB per video. Videos larger than the premium limit cannot be saved to storage even on Premium. To check your plan: use /premium or click Premium on the main menu.

Limits
How do I delete individual items from storage?

Step by step:
1. Click Media Storage on the main menu (or use /storage)
2. Select the storage box containing the items
3. Browse the list of media items
4. Click on an item → click Delete
5. Confirm deletion — this is permanent and cannot be undone

To delete everything: use Delete Box to remove the entire box and all contents.

Can I preview media before selecting it for a message?

Yes! When scheduling a message and you reach the media step:
1. Choose From Storage
2. Select a storage box
3. Each item shows a preview — you can see the image/video before picking it
4. Click on the one you want → it's attached to your scheduled message
5. Confirm and your message is ready with the selected media

Help Center Feedback & Support

Feedback & Support

11 articles

Every ticket goes to a human. Open Feedback in the bot (or /feedback), pick a category, and describe the issue — attach a file or screenshot if it helps.

What happens next
• You get a ticket number immediately.
• Replies arrive in the bot chat; you can continue the conversation in the same thread.
• My requests shows the status of every ticket you filed.

Bug reports with concrete details (job ID, time, what you expected vs. what happened) get fixed fastest.

Keep it clean
Feedback must not contain offensive language. One mild expression triggers a warning (the message is still sent); heavily offensive messages are blocked, and 3 warnings temporarily block new feedback. Mistaken flags can be reported from the warning itself.

Overview: TroubleshootingStart hereCommon ErrorsGuideNetwork ErrorsGuideTimeoutsGuideRate LimitedGuideMedia ErrorsGuideChannel ErrorsGuideForbiddenGuidePayment ErrorsGuideNo Post SentGuideLate PostGuideMedia FailsGuidePermissionGuideBot Down1 Q&AScheduled Message Didn’t Post? Common questions

How do I exit a stuck flow?

Use the /cancel command at any time to exit the current operation and return to the main menu.

Payment went through but Premium didn't activate

Wait 2-3 minutes — there can be a small delay with some payment providers. If still not active after 5 minutes, check with /premium. If Premium still shows as inactive, contact @MaximalXP with your user ID, payment method, and transaction details.

I used a referral link but didn't get Premium days

Referral Premium days are only credited when the referred person 1) is a NEW user (never used the bot before), and 2) connects a channel. Just starting the bot with the link is not enough. Check /referral to see your status. Contact @MaximalXP if requirements were met.

My scheduled messages stopped sending

Check: 1) Your sender bot is still connected and is admin in the channel. 2) You haven't hit the Free plan monthly send cap (100 per channel). 3) The channel hasn't been removed. 4) Your Premium hasn't expired (if you had channels above the free limit). Use /stats to check your status.

Premium ExpiryFrozen Assets
I accidentally deleted something — can I recover it?

If you have a backup (.fsback or .fspback file), you can restore it with /import. Without a backup, deleted data cannot be recovered. We recommend regular exports to avoid data loss.

How do I delete my account or all my data?

Contact @MaximalXP directly to request account deletion. You can also manually delete your data using the export/backup feature first to keep a copy. Your scheduled messages, media, and settings will be permanently removed.

Can I get a refund for Premium?

Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. Contact @MaximalXP directly with your payment details and reason for the refund request. Refunds are not guaranteed but are reviewed individually.

My bot token was revoked by @BotFather

If you reset your bot token in @BotFather, the old token stops working immediately. Go to Bots → 🔁 Replace Token under the bot and enter the new token from @BotFather. Your scheduled messages will resume once the new token is saved.

Help Center Privacy

Privacy

10 articles

What the bot stores and why:
• Telegram identifiers — your user ID and channel IDs, so the bot knows what it manages and for whom.
• Content you schedule — message texts and media references, kept only to deliver your posts on time.
• Settings — language, time zone, signatures, bot tokens you connect.
• Operational logs — delivery results, used to fix failures and show you statistics.

The bot never reads channels it is not connected to, never posts anything you did not schedule, and never shares your data with third parties. Deleting a message in the bot deletes it from storage; deleting your account deletes everything. Full details are in the website Privacy Policy.

Getting Started

New here? This section takes you from an empty chat to a published post: connect your channel, connect a sender bot, schedule the first message — then explore the tools that keep a channel running on autopilot.

The three setup steps are short guides with pictures of what to tap. After that, the glossary explains any term you meet along the way, and the SetDate topic covers bulk-creating schedules from a file.

    Getting Started

    Getting Started3 Q&A

    Three steps and your first post is scheduled. The whole setup usually takes five minutes.

    Step 1: Connect your channel
    Add @FastSchedulerBot as an administrator of your channel with at least the Post Messages permission. Then in the bot: Channels → Connect Channel, and send @yourchannel or simply forward any post from the channel.

    Step 2: Connect a sender bot — required
    Posts are delivered by your own bot; scheduling stays locked until every connected channel has one. Create a bot in @BotFather (/newbot), copy its token, and paste it in Bots → 🔑 I Have a Token. Then make your bot an administrator of the same channel, also with Post Messages.

    Step 3: Schedule your first message
    Tap 📅 Schedule a Message, enter the date and time (25.12.2025 10:00), type the post, preview, confirm. Done — it publishes itself.

    Each step has a detailed guide below, plus answers to the questions new users ask most.

    Common questions

    Do I need a sender bot to schedule messages?

    Yes - every channel needs its own sender bot to post. After connecting a channel, create a bot with @BotFather (or use an existing one), make it an admin in your channel, and connect it in Fast Scheduler from Bots. Your own bot also gives a professional look, low sending delays, and detailed channel leaderboards.

    How long does it take to set up?

    Most users are up and running in 5-10 minutes. Connecting a channel takes about 2 minutes, adding a sender bot takes 3-5 minutes, and scheduling your first message takes 1-2 minutes.

    What permissions does the bot need in my channel?

    The bot needs at minimum the Post Messages permission. For full functionality (deleting/editing posts), grant Delete Messages and Edit Messages as well.

      Connecting a Channel

      Getting Started6 Q&A

      Before you can schedule messages, you need to connect a Telegram channel.

      Requirements
      • The main bot @FastSchedulerBot must be an Administrator in the channel
      • Give it at least Post Messages permission
      • For sender bots: the sender bot must also be an admin

      How to Connect
      1. Add the bot to your channel as Administrator
      2. In Fast Scheduler, go to Connected Channel
      3. Click Connect Channel
      4. Send the channel username: @yourchannel
      • Or forward any message from the channel
      • Or send an invite link
      • Or send the channel ID (e.g., -1001234567890)

      Multiple Channels
      • Free plan: 1 channel
      • Premium: up to 3 channels
      • Switch between channels at any time during scheduling

      Removing a Channel
      • Go to Connected Channel → click on the channel
      • Scheduled messages for that channel will be paused

      Common Errors
      • "Bot is not an admin" — add the bot as admin in channel settings
      • "Channel not found" — check the username/link is correct
      • "Invalid format" — use @username or full invite link

      Common questions

      How do I connect my first channel?

      Step by step:
      1. Add the bot to your channel: Open your channel on Telegram → Channel Info → Administrators → Add Admin → search for @FastSchedulerBot → select it → grant at least Post Messages permission → confirm
      2. Connect in the bot: Click Connected Channel on the main menu → click Connect Channel
      3. Identify your channel: Send the channel username (@yourchannel) — OR forward a post from your channel — OR send an invite link — OR send the numeric channel ID (-1001234567890)
      4. Done! The channel appears in your list as connected.

      If you use a sender bot: also add your sender bot as admin in the same channel.

      Can I connect multiple channels?

      Free plan: 1 channel. Premium: up to 3 channels. Each channel can have its own sender bot and schedule. To add another: click Connected Channel → Connect Channel → follow the same steps. You can switch between channels during scheduling by selecting the desired one.

      Limits
      How do I remove a channel?

      Step by step:
      1. Click Connected Channel on the main menu
      2. Find the channel you want to remove
      3. Click the Remove button next to it
      4. Confirm — the channel is disconnected

      Important: Scheduled messages for that channel are paused, not deleted. They remain in your account with all content and settings. If you reconnect the same channel later (using the same method as first connection), the messages resume automatically.

      How do I change a channel's timezone?

      Step by step:
      1. Click Connected Channel on the main menu (or use /channel / /timezone)
      2. Select the channel you want to configure
      3. Click Timezone
      4. Scroll through the list and select your timezone (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo)
      5. The timezone is saved automatically

      All scheduled and recurring times for this channel will use the new timezone.

      How do I know which channel is connected to which bot?

      Click Connected Channel on the main menu. Each channel in the list shows its assigned sender bot username below the channel name. To change the bot assignment:
      1. Click Bots on the main menu
      2. Select the bot you want to reassign
      3. Click Change Channel and pick a different channel

      How do I set my channel's timezone?

      Use the Timezone option when viewing your channel settings.

      Time ZoneCalendar View

        Help CenterGetting StartedConnecting a Bot

        Connecting a Bot

        Getting Started7 Q&A

        Every channel needs its own sender bot - a Telegram bot you own that posts messages to your channel under the bot's name.

        Why Connect Your Own Bot?
        • Messages are sent from YOUR bot, not the main bot
        • Your bot's name and photo appear as the author
        • Professional appearance for your channel
        • Low sending delays — your messages go out through your bot, not the shared main bot queue
        • Detailed channel leaderboards — see most viewed, most reacted, and most commented posts for each channel

        How to Get a Bot Token
        1. Open @BotFather on Telegram
        2. Send /newbot and follow the instructions
        3. Choose a name and username for your bot
        4. Copy the token (format: 1234567890:ABCdef..._XYZ)
        5. Never share your token with anyone you don't trust

        How to Connect
        1. In Fast Scheduler, click Bots or use /bots
        2. Click 🔑 I Have a Token
        3. Send the bot token you copied from @BotFather
        4. Select which channel this bot should send to
        5. Make sure your bot is an Administrator in the target channel

        Limits
        • Free plan: 1 bot
        • Premium: up to 3 bots

        Managing Bots
        • Click Bots on the main menu to see all connected bots
        • You can replace a bot's token or disconnect it
        • Disconnecting a bot puts its channel back into "connect a sender bot" state — reconnect a bot to schedule again

        Inside Your Sender Bot
        • Management moves to the sender bot automatically when it is connected
        • Management → Hide Channel — strangers who start your bot won't see your channel name (Public Mode)
        • Management → Admins — give other people limited access to your channel
        • Statistics — open per-channel stats and leaderboards

        Troubleshooting
        • "Invalid token" — make sure you copied the FULL token from @BotFather
        • "Bot is not admin" — add your bot as an administrator in the channel
        • "Bot limit reached" — remove an existing bot or upgrade to Premium

        Common questions

        How do I replace a bot token?

        If you reset the token in @BotFather (or it was compromised), replace it here:
        1. Click Bots on the main menu (or use /bots)
        2. Tap 🔁 Replace Token under the bot
        3. Paste the new token from @BotFather and send
        4. The bot reconnects with the new token — scheduled messages resume automatically

        How do I disconnect a bot?

        Step by step:
        1. Click Bots on the main menu (or use /bots / /removebot)
        2. Find the bot in the list → tap 🗑 under it
        3. Confirm

        Note: the channel is not deleted — it returns to the "connect a sender bot" state, and its scheduled messages wait. When you connect a new bot to the channel, everything works again.

        Can I use the same bot for multiple channels?

        No, each sender bot can only be assigned to one channel. Each channel needs its own bot. This is a system limitation — if you have 3 channels, you need 3 sender bots (Premium). To see your bot-channel assignments: click Connected Channel on the main menu.

        Where do I manage my channel — main bot or sender bot?

        In the sender bot. Management moves to your sender bot automatically when you connect it — no extra setup. Inside the sender bot you get the Management menu: Hide Channel (Public Mode) and Admins. The main bot stays as your hub for scheduling, settings, language, and Premium. If the sender bot's token ever breaks, Fast Scheduler falls back to the main bot so posts are not lost.

        What is Hide Channel and how do I use it?

        Hide Channel is a privacy feature (Premium). When enabled, people who start your sender bot won't see your channel name. To toggle it: open the sender bot → Management → Hide Channel. Now when users start your bot, they see a generic welcome with an Open Main Bot button — not your channel name. Useful for keeping the channel private while the bot stays public.

        Why does it say my bot token is invalid?

        The token format is: 1234567890:ABCdef...XYZ. Common issues:
        • Not the full token: Copy the ENTIRE token from @BotFather, including the colon and all characters after it — no extra spaces
        • Token was reset: If you used /revoke in @BotFather, you must use the new token, not the old one
        • Bot was deleted: If the bot was deleted in @BotFather, create a new one with /newbot

        To fix: click Bots → 🔁 Replace Token under the bot → enter the correct token.

        How do I see statistics for my sender bot?

        Per-channel stats and leaderboards are a Premium feature. Open Statistics in the main bot (or /stats) and pick the channel — the full view opens with average views, comments and reactions, plus leaderboards (views / comments / reactions) with period filters. Each channel row can also deep-link straight into the sender bot that posts there.

                Send Your First Post

                Getting Started1 Q&A

                1. Add @FastSchedulerBot to your channel as an Administrator (Post Messages permission is enough).
                2. In the bot: Connected Channel → Connect Channel, then send @yourchannel or forward any post.
                3. Connect a sender bot for the channel from Bots (create one via @BotFather or connect an existing bot) - required before you can schedule.
                4. Tap Schedule Message, pick the channel, enter a date and time (e.g. 25.12.2025 10:00).
                5. Type your message, attach media if you like, review the preview and confirm.

                That's it - your sender bot posts for you at the chosen time. See Getting Started for the detailed step-by-step guide.

                Common questions

                What is the fastest way to schedule a message?

                Use /schedule, pick a channel, send the date/time and message, then confirm. For many posts at once, upload a .txt file in batch format.

                  Quick Tips

                  Getting Started
                  • Use HH:MM alone to schedule for today at that time.
                  • Upload a .txt file during scheduling to create many messages at once (blank line = new message).
                  • Use Message List (/list) to edit or delete posts later.
                  • Add a sender bot so posts appear from your own bot's name.
                  • Set your time zone so times mean what you expect.
                  • Anything you type in the bot works in both bots: @FastSchedulerBot and @SetDate_bot share your settings.

                    Help CenterGetting StartedGlossary

                    Glossary

                    Getting Started

                    Six terms cover most of the bot:

                    • Channel — the Telegram channel your posts go to. The bot must be its admin.
                    • Sender bot — your own bot that actually delivers the posts. Required for every channel; one bot per channel.
                    • Scheduled message — a one-time post queued for a specific date and time.
                    • Recurring message — a post that repeats (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly) until paused or deleted.
                    • Signature — text appended to every post in a channel.
                    • Premium — the paid plan: more channels and bots, unlimited sends, bigger media storage.

                    Tap any term below for the full explanation.

                      Channel

                      Getting Started

                      A Telegram channel is where your audience sees your posts. Fast Scheduler connects to your channel, then posts your scheduled and recurring messages to it.

                      You must be the owner or an admin, and the bot must be an administrator with at least Post Messages permission.

                      Free plan: 1 channel. Premium: up to 3 channels, each with its own sender bot and time zone.

                        Help CenterGetting StartedSender Bot

                        Sender Bot

                        Getting Started

                        A sender bot is a Telegram bot you create via @BotFather. Fast Scheduler uses it to post messages so they appear from your bot's name. Every channel needs one sender bot - connecting it is required after the channel is connected.

                        Benefits: your brand on every post, lower sending delay, per-channel statistics and leaderboards.

                        Each sender bot is assigned to one channel. Free plan: 1 bot. Premium: up to 3.

                                        Help CenterGetting StartedSetDate Integration

                                        SetDate Integration

                                        Getting Started

                                        Need to schedule many posts at once? The SetDate Bot lets you bulk-create schedules in minutes.

                                        What is SetDate?
                                        SetDate is a companion bot that helps you create multiple scheduled messages quickly. Instead of entering each message one by one, you prepare all messages in SetDate and import them in one click.

                                        How It Works
                                        1. Click Open SetDate during the scheduling flow
                                        2. The SetDate bot opens with your context
                                        3. Set a start date and how many posts per day
                                        4. Define posting times (e.g., 09:00, 14:00, 18:00)
                                        5. Send your text messages — one per block separated by blank lines (or one by one, then Done); .txt upload works too, media is added later during import
                                        6. Generate a schedule file
                                        7. Click Import to Fast Scheduler
                                        8. You return to Fast Scheduler with all messages pre-loaded
                                        9. Choose media options and confirm

                                        Benefits
                                        • Schedule 10, 50, or 100+ posts in just a few minutes
                                        • Auto-assigns dates and times to each message
                                        • Supports European and American date formats
                                        • Supports inline buttons with custom layouts
                                        • Plain-text posts; <inline> button markup carries over to Fast Scheduler

                                        Features
                                        • Flexible time parsing: 08:00, 2:00 PM, 12;00
                                        • Upload .txt files with your posts
                                        • Download your schedule as .txt, .csv, or .json
                                        • Summary with dates and totals plus downloads before importing
                                        • One-click import back to Fast Scheduler

                                        Language Sync
                                        Both bots share your language preference. When you change the language in one, the other bot sends you a message asking if you want to sync the change — tap Yes to apply it.

                                          Advertising & Promotion

                                          Getting Started4 Q&A

                                          To advertise to Fast Scheduler users, contact @MaximalXP to discuss placements and packages.

                                          For standard audience reach, Telegram's own Telegram Ads platform is also an option for public channels.

                                          Love the bot? Earn free Premium days by inviting friends - use /referral.

                                          Common questions

                                          How much does advertising cost?

                                          Pricing varies depending on the placement type, duration, and reach. Contact @MaximalXP directly for a custom quote. Telegram Ads (native) have their own pricing at ads.telegram.org.

                                          Can I advertise my Telegram channel here?

                                          Yes! Contact @MaximalXP to discuss promotional opportunities including sponsored placements, cross-promotion, and featured listings.

                                          Is there a self-service ad platform?

                                          For Telegram's native advertising, use ads.telegram.org — it's a self-service platform. For custom placements within Fast Scheduler, contact @MaximalXP directly.

                                          Can I sponsor a specific broadcast message?

                                          Yes, sponsored messages within bot broadcasts are available. Contact @MaximalXP to discuss your content, timing, and pricing.

                                            Help CenterScheduling Messages

                                            Scheduling Messages

                                            Scheduling Messages

                                            Everything about one-time scheduling: the basic flow, every content type the bot can post, and the tools to manage what you have queued.

                                            The basic flow
                                            1. Tap Schedule Message (or send /schedule).
                                            2. Pick the channel — the bot you paired with it will do the posting.
                                            3. Enter the date and time: use the format DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM (for example 25.12.2025 10:00) or send it in the same message as the text.
                                            4. Send the message content — plain text or with photos, videos, documents, polls, stickers, voice, locations.
                                            5. Review the preview and confirm.

                                            The post goes out automatically at the chosen time, in the channel's time zone. Before scheduling works at all, two things must be connected: the channel (bot as admin) and its sender bot — see Getting Started if you are not there yet.

                                            Managing the queue
                                            Everything you schedule lands in the Message List and Calendar: preview before it posts, edit any detail, or delete what changed. The topics below cover each content type and every management tool.

                                              Scheduling Messages

                                              During scheduling, after sending the text, choose how to attach media:

                                              • Random - each message gets a random file from the mix you sent (any types mixed).
                                              • Sequential - files are assigned in order, repeating as needed.
                                              • From Storage - reuse saved media.

                                              Free plan videos: up to 25MB. Premium: up to 50MB.

                                                  Forwarding is a fast way to re-post your best content at a later time.

                                                    Help CenterScheduling MessagesFormatting & Inline Buttons

                                                    Formatting & Inline Buttons

                                                    Scheduling Messages3 Q&A

                                                    You can use Telegram markdown-style formatting in your messages:

                                                    **bold** — bold
                                                    __italic__ — italic
                                                    ___underline___ — underline
                                                    ~~strikethrough~~ — strikethrough
                                                    ||spoiler|| — <tg-spoiler>spoiler</tg-spoiler>
                                                    `code` — inline code
                                                    ```block``` — code block
                                                    [text](url) — <a href="https://example.com">text link</a>

                                                    Note: URLs in text are not automatically clickable in sent messages. Use inline buttons for clickable links.

                                                    ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                    Inline Buttons — Full Guide
                                                    ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

                                                    Add clickable buttons below any post. There is no button-builder in the bot — just type the markup into your message text (usually at the end).

                                                    Basic Syntax
                                                    <inline>Button Text<link="https://url.com">

                                                    Multiple Buttons (Each on its own row)
                                                    <inline>Buy Now<link="https://shop.com">
                                                    <inline>Learn More<link="https://info.com">

                                                    Side by Side with --
                                                    <inline>Buy<link="https://shop.com"> -- <inline>Info<link="https://info.com">
                                                    Result: [Buy] [Info] (same row)

                                                    New Row with //
                                                    <inline>Catalog<link="https://shop.com"> // <inline>Support<link="https://support.com">
                                                    Result:
                                                    [Catalog]
                                                    [Support]

                                                    Full Layout Example
                                                    <inline>Catalog<link="https://shop.com"> -- <inline>Sale<link="https://shop.com/sale"> // <inline>Reviews<link="https://shop.com/reviews"> -- <inline>Support<link="https://support.com">
                                                    Result:
                                                    [Catalog] [Sale]
                                                    [Reviews] [Support]

                                                    Button Colors
                                                    Add style="success" (green), style="primary" (blue) or style="danger" (red) inside the tag:
                                                    <inline>Buy Now<link="https://shop.com" style="success"> -- <inline>Remove<link="https://shop.com/remove" style="danger">
                                                    Unknown styles are ignored.

                                                    Important:
                                                    • Use full URLs with https://
                                                    • Keep button text short (a few words) so it fits on phone screens
                                                    • The markup lines are removed from the published post — buttons appear BELOW the message text

                                                    Examples
                                                    • Link button: <inline>Visit Site<link="https://example.com">
                                                    • Side by side: <inline>Like<link="https://t.me/yourbot?start=like"> -- <inline>Dislike<link="https://t.me/yourbot?start=dislike">

                                                    Callback Buttons
                                                    <inline>Action Name<callback="action_data">

                                                    Callback buttons send data back to the bot instead of opening a link — use them for actions, confirmations, and interactive posts. They follow the same layout rules (-- for the same row, // for a new row) and can be mixed with link buttons. Colors work here too: <inline>Confirm<callback="confirm" style="success">.

                                                    Important:
                                                    • Callback data is limited to 64 bytes
                                                    • Malformed <inline> markup shows a warning — fix the syntax and resend
                                                    • Callback buttons only work when the bot recognizes the data — you'll be warned before scheduling if a callback has no matching handler

                                                    Common questions

                                                    What formatting options are supported?

                                                    Supported: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, pre, spoiler (||text||), inline links, and inline buttons via <inline>Text<link="url">. HTML tags also work if you prefer.

                                                    Supported Content Types (Free Plan)Media Selection Types
                                                    Can I combine spoilers with other formatting?

                                                    Yes, spoilers work alongside bold, italic, and other formatting. Wrap the formatted text in || on both sides.

                                                    Supported Content Types (Free Plan)
                                                    Can I combine multiple formats?

                                                    Yes! You can combine formats. For example: *bold and _italic_* will show as bold and italic text.

                                                        Help CenterScheduling MessagesMedia Selection Types

                                                        Media Selection Types

                                                        Scheduling Messages5 Q&A

                                                        After sending your message text, you choose how media (photos, videos, etc.) is attached.

                                                        1. Random Mix Mode
                                                        • Send multiple files during scheduling — photos, videos, documents, anything, even mixed together
                                                        • Each scheduled message gets a random item from your collection, sent with the right method for its type
                                                        • Different media each time — great for variety and engagement

                                                        2. Normal Photo Mode
                                                        • Send one photo or video during scheduling
                                                        • That single media is attached to every scheduled message
                                                        • Simple and consistent — same image for all posts

                                                        3. Sequential Order
                                                        • Send multiple media files in order
                                                        • They are assigned in sequence to your messages
                                                        • First media → first message, second → second, etc.
                                                        • After the last media, repeats from the first
                                                        • Choose order by date (upload time) or sent (input order)

                                                        4. From Storage
                                                        • Use media you've saved in Media Storage
                                                        • Pick from your saved collection
                                                        • Saves time if you reuse media across multiple schedules

                                                        5. No Media
                                                        • Text-only messages
                                                        • No photos, videos, or files attached

                                                        Tips:
                                                        • For photo albums, send multiple photos in one batch using Normal mode
                                                        • Videos must be under plan limits (Free: up to 25MB, Premium: up to 50MB)
                                                        • You can mix text-only and media messages in the same batch

                                                        Common questions

                                                        Can I mix photos and videos in the same batch?

                                                        Yes! You can mix photos, videos, documents, animations, and voice messages in any mode (Random, Sequential, or Normal). Each message will get one item from your collection.

                                                        What are the video size limits?

                                                        Free plan: videos up to 25MB each. Premium: videos up to 50MB when sent directly in messages, up to 50MB when saved in Media Storage.

                                                        Limits
                                                        Does the bot support spoilers in media?

                                                        Yes. During scheduling, toggle spoiler on/off for photos and videos. You can also use ||text|| in messages for text spoilers.

                                                        Formatting & Inline ButtonsSupported Content Types (Free Plan)
                                                        Can I schedule polls with multiple correct answers?

                                                        Yes. Quiz mode supports a single correct answer. Poll mode supports multiple correct answers. Choose the type when scheduling.

                                                        Schedule
                                                        What file types are supported?

                                                        Supported: photos (JPEG, PNG, GIF), videos (MP4, MOV, AVI), animations (GIF as animation), documents (PDF, DOC, XLS, ZIP, etc.), voice messages (OGG), audio files (MP3).

                                                          Edit Messages

                                                          Scheduling Messages4 Q&A

                                                          Change the content, schedule, or settings of an existing message.

                                                          How to Access:
                                                          • From Message List: preview a message, then tap Edit
                                                          • Use /edit followed by a job ID

                                                          What You Can Edit:
                                                          Text — change the message content
                                                          Date/Time — reschedule for a different time
                                                          Media — add, change, or remove attached media
                                                          Channel — send to a different channel
                                                          Recurring Schedule — change daily/weekly/monthly settings

                                                          Editing a Recurring Message:
                                                          • You can change the time, day, or interval
                                                          • Changes take effect immediately for all future sends
                                                          • Past sends are not affected

                                                          Duplicate a Message (⧾ /dub):
                                                          • Use /dub to create an exact copy of a scheduled message
                                                          • Useful for creating variations of the same post
                                                          • The copy starts in edit mode so you can change the date/time

                                                          See also: Message List and Delete Messages.

                                                          Common questions

                                                          How do I find messages to edit?

                                                          Use Message List or Search to find the message, then preview and tap Edit.

                                                          Message ListDelete MessagesScheduling Messages
                                                          Can I duplicate a message?

                                                          Yes! Use /dub to duplicate a scheduled message into an editable copy with a new date/time.

                                                          Message ListScheduling Messages
                                                          Can I change just the date/time without altering content?

                                                          Yes. Preview the message, tap Edit, then choose Date/Time. The text and media stay unchanged.

                                                          Message ListScheduling Messages
                                                          Can I move a message to a different channel?

                                                          Yes. Preview the message, tap Edit, then choose Channel. Pick any of your connected channels.

                                                            Help CenterScheduling MessagesDelete Messages

                                                            Delete Messages

                                                            Scheduling Messages

                                                            Remove scheduled or recurring messages you no longer need.

                                                            How to delete:
                                                            • From Message List: tap the 🗑 trash icon next to a message → confirm.
                                                            • Use 🗑 Delete All at the bottom of the list — it removes all scheduled and recurring messages at once after a confirmation that shows exactly how many messages will go.
                                                            • Use 🗑 Delete by ID and enter a job ID to remove one specific message (scheduled IDs look like s482913_7, recurring IDs like r482913_7 — you can copy them from the list).

                                                            What happens after deletion:
                                                            • Deleted scheduled messages are removed from the queue and will NOT be sent.
                                                            • Deleted recurring messages are stopped and removed from the scheduler.
                                                            • Deletion is permanent — it cannot be undone.

                                                            Tip: to find a job ID first, use Message List or /search. Removing a channel is different — see Remove a Channel.

                                                              Recurring Messages

                                                              Scheduling Messages6 Q&A

                                                              Recurring messages repeat automatically - daily, on chosen weekdays, or monthly.

                                                              How to create:
                                                              1. Tap Recurring Message.
                                                              2. Pick the channel and the interval (daily/weekly/monthly).
                                                              3. Set the send time.
                                                              4. Send the content and confirm.

                                                              Free plan: 1 recurring message. Premium: unlimited.

                                                              Manage them from Message List - edit time, pause, resume, or delete. Recurring messages expire after 365 days.

                                                              See also: Pause & Resume for temporary stopping.

                                                              Common questions

                                                              Can I pause a recurring message without deleting it?

                                                              Yes. Step by step:
                                                              1. Click Message List on the main menu (or use /list)
                                                              2. Find your recurring message (look for the icon)
                                                              3. Click on it → then click ⏸ Pause
                                                              4. The message will stop sending until you resume it
                                                              5. To resume later: click on the paused message → click Resume

                                                              Unlike deletion, pausing preserves all settings so you can continue later.

                                                              What happens to recurring messages when Premium expires?

                                                              If you have more than 1 recurring message, you'll see a Choose What to Keep menu on the first day after expiry. Select 1 recurring message to keep — the excess are paused (not deleted). If you reactivate Premium later (/premium → choose a plan → pay), the paused messages resume. Free plan allows 1 recurring message which stays active.

                                                              Premium Expiry
                                                              Can I edit the content of a recurring message?

                                                              Yes. Step by step:
                                                              1. Click Message List on the main menu (or use /list)
                                                              2. Open the recurring list and tap the ✏️ button on your rule
                                                              3. Send the replacement (new text, new time, or both — media works too)
                                                              4. Confirm — the rule updates and all future sends use the new version

                                                              The changes take effect immediately for all future sends.

                                                              How do I change the time a recurring message sends?

                                                              Step by step:
                                                              1. Click Message List (or /list)
                                                              2. Open the recurring list and tap the ✏️ button on your rule
                                                              3. Enter a new time (e.g., 14:30 for 2:30 PM)
                                                              4. For weekly: change the day as well. For monthly: change the day number
                                                              5. Confirm — the new time takes effect immediately

                                                              The time is in your channel's timezone. To change the timezone: go to Channels → select the channel → Time Zone → pick your zone.

                                                              Can I have multiple recurring messages?

                                                              Free plan: 1 recurring message only. Premium: unlimited. Each can have its own schedule, content, media, and target channel. To add more: click Recurring Messages on the main menu (or /recurring) and follow the steps.

                                                              Limits
                                                              How long does a free recurring message last?

                                                              Free plan recurring messages expire after 1 year from creation. Premium recurring messages never expire. You'll get a notification before a free recurring message expires with options to renew or upgrade. To check your status: use /premium or click Premium on the main menu.

                                                                Help CenterScheduling MessagesHow You Can Use Recurring Messages

                                                                How You Can Use Recurring Messages

                                                                Scheduling Messages5 Q&A

                                                                Recurring messages handle most repeat-posting needs. A few common ways to use them:

                                                                Daily Digest
                                                                Send a daily roundup every morning:
                                                                1. Use Recurring Message, set it to repeat every day.
                                                                2. Enter the send time, e.g. 09:00.
                                                                3. Write the digest content (or use the SetDate bot to prepare a full month).

                                                                Event Reminder
                                                                Remind your audience about an event:
                                                                • Schedule an announcement at the event time.
                                                                • Add reminder posts: -1 day, -3 hours, -10 minutes.
                                                                • Use inline buttons for "Add to calendar" or "Buy ticket".

                                                                News Roundup
                                                                Post a daily or weekly news roundup:
                                                                • Create a recurring message that runs on weekdays.
                                                                • Use SetDate to preload a month of news scripts.
                                                                • Attach a header image from your media storage.

                                                                Promo Blast
                                                                Schedule a promotion across channels:
                                                                • Write the promo and add inline buttons ("Shop", "Learn more").
                                                                • Schedule it at your best posting time per channel.
                                                                • Add follow-up reminders on days 2 and 5.

                                                                Daily Quote
                                                                Post a quote every morning:
                                                                • Use a recurring daily message at 08:00.
                                                                • Prepare a month of quotes in SetDate and import them.
                                                                • Optionally attach a matching image from storage.

                                                                Common questions

                                                                Can I schedule the same daily post for every day?

                                                                Yes — use a Recurring Message set to repeat every day with a fixed time. On Premium you can run unlimited recurring messages per channel.

                                                                Can I schedule a one-time event post?

                                                                Yes — schedule a one-time message with the exact date and time. It sends once and stays in your Message List for review.

                                                                Can news posts go out at the same time weekly?

                                                                Yes — use a recurring message repeating weekly on the day/time you want. Adjust the timezone first so the time matches your audience.

                                                                How do I run a promo post series?

                                                                Schedule each promo as a one-time post (or a recurring series) with its own date and time, then preview before confirming. Batch scheduling via a .txt file makes large series fast.

                                                                Can I schedule a daily quote?

                                                                Yes — a recurring message repeating every day at your chosen time is ideal for daily quotes. Change the quote by editing the recurring message.

                                                                  Pause & Resume

                                                                  Scheduling Messages

                                                                  Pause and resume recurring messages without deleting them.

                                                                  How to Pause:
                                                                  1. Open Message List (or use /list)
                                                                  2. Select Recurring Messages
                                                                  3. Find the message you want to pause
                                                                  4. Tap the ⏸ button next to it
                                                                  5. Confirm the pause

                                                                  What Happens When Paused:
                                                                  • The message stops sending immediately
                                                                  • The message is NOT deleted — it stays in your list
                                                                  • The schedule is preserved
                                                                  • You can see it marked as 'Paused' in the list

                                                                  How to Resume:
                                                                  1. Open Message List
                                                                  2. Select Recurring Messages
                                                                  3. Find the paused message (marked with ⏸ Paused)
                                                                  4. Tap the ▶ button next to it
                                                                  5. Confirm the resume

                                                                  What Happens When Resumed:
                                                                  • The message starts sending again on its schedule
                                                                  • No content or settings are lost
                                                                  • The next send happens at the next scheduled time

                                                                  Use Cases:
                                                                  • Seasonal content — pause holiday posts when out of season
                                                                  • Temporary breaks — pause during vacations or events
                                                                  • Testing — pause to review content before going live
                                                                  • Rotation — pause one message while another takes priority

                                                                  Tip: Pausing is better than deleting if you might want to use the message again later.

                                                                    Multi-Channel Scheduling

                                                                    Scheduling Messages1 Q&A

                                                                    Premium unlocks up to 3 channels, each with its own sender bot, schedule, and identity.

                                                                    How it works
                                                                    • Every channel pairs with its own sender bot — posts always appear from that bot's name.
                                                                    • When scheduling, you pick the target channel.
                                                                    • Each channel keeps its own time zone, signature, and settings.

                                                                    Everyday workflow
                                                                    • Use Message List with the channel filter to review one channel at a time.
                                                                    • Cross-posting the same message? Schedule it once per channel.

                                                                    Free plan covers 1 channel and 1 bot; Premium raises both to 3.

                                                                    Common questions

                                                                    Can I schedule the same message to all channels?

                                                                    Not automatically. Schedule the message separately for each channel.

                                                                      Advanced Scheduling: Edit, Delete, Polls & More

                                                                      Scheduling Messages

                                                                      Beyond the basic flow, the scheduler covers a set of practical extras. Here is the complete picture.

                                                                      Editing scheduled messages
                                                                      Everything about a pending message stays editable until the moment it is sent: open the Message List, tap the message, and choose 🔄 Replace (or use /edit with the job ID). You can change the text, the date and time, the attached media, and even the target channel. The bot shows a fresh preview before saving.

                                                                      Deleting messages
                                                                      Pending messages can be removed one by one from the Message List, via /delete, or by job ID. Delete All wipes every scheduled and recurring message for a channel at once — use it with care, the bot asks for confirmation first.

                                                                      Scheduling forwardable content
                                                                      Anything you can forward inside Telegram can be scheduled: forward a post from another channel while scheduling, and the bot copies its text and media into your own post. Polls and quizzes work the same way: create the poll in any chat and forward it to the bot during scheduling (or create it inline in the bot if your Telegram version supports poll sending), then pick a date. Only anonymous polls may post in channels — that is a Telegram rule for channels, not a bot limit.

                                                                      Special content types
                                                                      • Location and venues — send the location during scheduling.
                                                                      • Voice messages and video notes — recorded or forwarded as usual.
                                                                      • Animated GIFs and stickers — stickers can even carry a text caption, posted right after the sticker.

                                                                      Time zones
                                                                      Every date you enter is interpreted in the channel's time zone, so a channel with an international audience posts exactly when its readers are awake. Set or check it under Channels → the channel → Time Zone, or with /timezone.
