                                                                                                                            Premium

                                                                                                                            Premium7 Q&A

                                                                                                                            Common questions

                                                                                                                            How do I purchase Premium?

                                                                                                                            Step by step:
                                                                                                                            1. Click Premium on the main menu (or use /premium)
                                                                                                                            2. Choose a plan: Monthly (auto-renewing), 3-month, 6-month, or Yearly (prepaid, one-time)
                                                                                                                            3. Select payment method: Telegram Stars (in-app purchase)
                                                                                                                            4. Follow the payment provider's instructions
                                                                                                                            5. Premium activates immediately after confirmation

                                                                                                                            If not active after 5 min, see Premium Troubleshooting sub-topic.

                                                                                                                            Premium Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                            How do I cancel my Premium auto-renewal?

                                                                                                                            Step by step:
                                                                                                                            1. Click Premium on the main menu (or use /premium)
                                                                                                                            2. Click ❌ Cancel Premium
                                                                                                                            3. Select a reason (optional) → confirm with ✅ Yes, Cancel Premium
                                                                                                                            4. Your Premium stays active until the paid period ends
                                                                                                                            (Cancel applies to the auto-renewing monthly plan; prepaid 3/6-month and yearly plans never auto-renew.)
                                                                                                                            5. Changed your mind before it ends? Open Premium again and buy a plan — you are Premium again instantly.

                                                                                                                            What happens when Premium expires (full timeline)?

                                                                                                                            Here is how the Premium expiry process works — from the moment your subscription ends to the final cleanup. Nothing is deleted in the first days; you have time to choose what to keep.

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            Before Expiry — What to Expect
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            • You will receive a notification a few days before your Premium ends
                                                                                                                            • If auto-renew is on and the payment succeeds, nothing changes — you stay Premium
                                                                                                                            • If payment fails or you cancel, the expiry timeline below begins on the last day of your paid period

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            Day 0 — Notification & Choose What to Keep
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            • You receive a detailed notification with the Choose What to Keep interactive menu
                                                                                                                            • You select which channels, sender bots, recurring messages, and media storage boxes to keep within Free plan limits
                                                                                                                            • How choosing works: each item has a toggle button — tap to mark Keep or Remove. Selecting a channel auto-selects its sender bot. When you finish, tap Save Selection
                                                                                                                            • If you don't choose: the system keeps the most recent channel, its bot, the newest recurring message, and the newest media storage box automatically

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            Days 1-2 — Grace Period
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            • Everything works normally — all messages send to all channels
                                                                                                                            • You can still change your keep choices if you want

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            Day 3 — First Warning
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            • Notification: "Messages will stop tomorrow"
                                                                                                                            • All messages still sent today
                                                                                                                            • Media deletion warning if you haven't picked a storage box to keep

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            Day 4 — Messages to Excess Channels Stop
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            • Messages to non-kept channels stop being sent
                                                                                                                            • Kept channels continue normally — no disruption for what you chose to keep
                                                                                                                            • Signatures are stripped from all sent messages (signatures are a Premium feature)
                                                                                                                            • You get a prompt to download a full backup of your data as an importable .fsback file
                                                                                                                            • What happens to non-chosen items: they are frozen (not deleted). Their scheduled messages are skipped but preserved. You can still export them

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            Days 14-15 — Mid-Wait Notices
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            • Day 14: "Disconnect in 3 weeks" notice
                                                                                                                            • Day 15: Mid-wait reminder

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            Day 17 — Media Cleanup
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            • Non-kept media storages are permanently deleted
                                                                                                                            • Your kept storage is trimmed to the newest 100 items (videos are removed first)

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            Day 35 + 12 Hours — Final Disconnect
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            • 12-hour warning on day 35
                                                                                                                            • After 12 hours: excess channels are disconnected, excess sender bot tokens are removed
                                                                                                                            • All signatures are permanently deleted
                                                                                                                            • Your account is now fully on the Free plan

                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            How to Reactivate
                                                                                                                            ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
                                                                                                                            At any point before the final disconnect: use /premium or click Premium → choose a plan → pay. Everything restores instantly — channels, bots, messages, and media.

                                                                                                                            After final disconnect, you can still re-subscribe but need to reconnect channels manually.

                                                                                                                            See also: Item Freezing and Premium Expiry topics below for more details.

                                                                                                                            Premium ExpiryFrozen Assets
                                                                                                                            How do I choose which channels to keep on expiry?

                                                                                                                            On day 0 after expiry, you get an interactive Choose What to Keep menu. Each channel, sender bot, and recurring message has a toggle button — tap to mark Keep or Remove.

                                                                                                                            How it works:
                                                                                                                            • Selecting a channel auto-selects its assigned sender bot
                                                                                                                            • You can only keep as many items as the Free plan allows (e.g., 1 channel, 1 bot, 1 recurring message)
                                                                                                                            • Once done, tap Save Selection
                                                                                                                            • Then you choose a media storage box to keep (you can keep 1 box)

                                                                                                                            If you don't choose: the system auto-selects the most recent channel, its bot, the newest recurring message, and the newest media storage box.

                                                                                                                            See Item Freezing below for what happens to items you don't select.

                                                                                                                            Frozen Assets
                                                                                                                            Will my media be deleted when Premium expires?

                                                                                                                            Media you choose to keep is safe. On day 0 you pick 1 storage to keep. Day 3 is a final warning. Day 17: excess storages are permanently deleted. Your kept storage is trimmed to the newest 100 items (videos are removed first, oldest first). To keep everything: renew Premium with /premium before day 17.

                                                                                                                            Premium ExpiryFrozen Assets
                                                                                                                            What is Signatures and how do I use it?

                                                                                                                            Add a signature once and every post in that channel carries it: send /signature (or tap 📝 Signature on the review screen), pick the channel, and send the text. Manage or remove it any time from the same menu.

                                                                                                                            Signatures (Premium)
                                                                                                                            How do I earn free Premium days?

                                                                                                                            Use the Referral Program to invite friends, or redeem a Promo Code.

                                                                                                                              Premium Features

                                                                                                                              Premium

                                                                                                                              What Premium gives you:
                                                                                                                              • 3 connected channels and 3 sender bots (Free: 1/1).
                                                                                                                              • Unlimited scheduled, recurring, and sent messages (Free: 100 pending / 100 sends per month).
                                                                                                                              • Up to 20 media storage boxes with 500 items total (Free: 1 box / 100 items).
                                                                                                                              • Videos in storage, 4K media, and larger uploads (up to 50MB videos, 100 MB media).
                                                                                                                              • Signatures, paginated leaderboards (views / comments / reactions / top commentators), and unlimited report schedules.
                                                                                                                              • Sender-bot management: Hide Channel (Public Mode) and channel Admins.

                                                                                                                              Open Premium for the full comparison.

                                                                                                                                  Buy Premium

                                                                                                                                  Premium

                                                                                                                                  1. Open Premium (main menu or /premium).
                                                                                                                                  2. Choose a plan:
                                                                                                                                  • ⭐ Standard monthly subscription — auto-renews, cancel anytime
                                                                                                                                  • 3️⃣ 3 months — prepaid, save 10% vs paying monthly
                                                                                                                                  • 6️⃣ 6 months — prepaid, save 14% vs paying monthly
                                                                                                                                  • 1️⃣ Yearly — prepaid, best per-month price
                                                                                                                                  3. Pick a payment method: Telegram Stars.
                                                                                                                                  4. Follow the instructions and confirm.
                                                                                                                                  5. Premium activates immediately after payment confirms.

                                                                                                                                  Prepaid 3/6-month and yearly plans are one-time purchases — they never auto-renew. The monthly subscription auto-renews until you cancel. Promo codes can be applied before paying; referral days are activated separately from the referral menu — see the Premium menu.

                                                                                                                                                                Help CenterPremiumFrozen Assets

                                                                                                                                                                Frozen Assets

                                                                                                                                                                Premium

                                                                                                                                                                When Premium expires, the assets that don't fit your free plan are frozen first and disconnected later - they are NOT deleted at once.

                                                                                                                                                                What gets frozen:
                                                                                                                                                                • Channels beyond the free limit stop receiving messages after day 3.
                                                                                                                                                                • Sender bots of frozen channels are turned off.
                                                                                                                                                                • Recurring messages beyond the free limit are paused.
                                                                                                                                                                • Media storages you didn't choose are deleted on day 17.
                                                                                                                                                                • Signatures are stripped from outgoing messages and removed at disconnect.

                                                                                                                                                                What keeps working:
                                                                                                                                                                • Your kept channel and its sender bot continue as normal.
                                                                                                                                                                • Scheduled messages on the kept channel keep sending.
                                                                                                                                                                • Your account, settings, language and referral days remain.

                                                                                                                                                                Reactivate Premium before the final disconnect to unfreeze everything instantly.

                                                                                                                                                                  Help CenterPremiumPremium Expiry

                                                                                                                                                                  Premium Expiry

                                                                                                                                                                  Premium

                                                                                                                                                                  When your Premium subscription ends, nothing is deleted on day one. You get a grace period, reminders, and a chance to choose what to keep.

                                                                                                                                                                  The timeline at a glance:
                                                                                                                                                                  • Before expiry: you receive reminders at 7, 3 and 1 day(s) left.
                                                                                                                                                                  • Day 0: a "Choose What to Keep" menu appears - pick up to 1 channel, 1 bot and 1 recurring message, plus (if you use it) the media storage box you want to keep.
                                                                                                                                                                  • Days 1-2: everything still works normally; you can change your choices.
                                                                                                                                                                  • Day 3: you get a final warning and an automatic backup file (.fsback).
                                                                                                                                                                  • Day 4: messages to the channels you did NOT keep stop sending. Your kept channel keeps working.
                                                                                                                                                                  • Day 17: media cleanup - non-kept storage boxes are deleted and the kept box is trimmed to 100 items (videos first).
                                                                                                                                                                  • Day 35 + 12 h: final warning, then excess channels and sender bots are disconnected and their data removed. Signatures are deleted.

                                                                                                                                                                  Good news: renew at any point before the final disconnect and everything restores instantly - channels, bots, messages and media.

                                                                                                                                                                  See the sub-topics below for the grace period, frozen assets, renewal and refunds.

                                                                                                                                                                    Help CenterPremiumGrace Period

                                                                                                                                                                    Grace Period

                                                                                                                                                                    Premium

                                                                                                                                                                    After your Premium expires you have a grace period before anything is limited. During it:
                                                                                                                                                                    • All messages keep sending to every channel.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Nothing is frozen or deleted yet.
                                                                                                                                                                    • You can still change your "keep" choices.
                                                                                                                                                                    • A renew prompt with pay again / change plan / cancel is shown.

                                                                                                                                                                    If you renew during the grace period, Premium is restored instantly and the expiry process is cancelled. After the grace period ends (day 3), the limits from your keep-selection start being applied.

                                                                                                                                                                      Help CenterPremiumRenew

                                                                                                                                                                      Renew

                                                                                                                                                                      Premium

                                                                                                                                                                      Renewing restores your full Premium account - usually instantly.

                                                                                                                                                                      How to renew:
                                                                                                                                                                      1. Open Premium (main menu or /premium).
                                                                                                                                                                      2. Tap Pay Again or choose a plan.
                                                                                                                                                                      3. Pay with Telegram Stars.
                                                                                                                                                                      4. Premium activates immediately after payment confirms.

                                                                                                                                                                      If you're in the middle of the expiry process:
                                                                                                                                                                      • Before day 4: everything is restored, nothing is lost.
                                                                                                                                                                      • Between day 4 and day 35: excess channels/bots were frozen but still connected - they are restored.
                                                                                                                                                                      • After day 35: excess channels and bots were disconnected; you re-connect them manually after renewing.

                                                                                                                                                                      Auto-renew: monthly Stars plans renew automatically. Yearly Stars plans are one-time payments - you renew manually.

                                                                                                                                                                        Reactivate

                                                                                                                                                                        Premium

                                                                                                                                                                        Premium can be reactivated after it expires or even after the final disconnect.

                                                                                                                                                                        • Before the final disconnect (day 35+12h): open /premium, pay, and everything is restored automatically.
                                                                                                                                                                        • After the final disconnect: subscribe again, then re-connect your excess channels and sender bots manually - the bot will guide you through it.

                                                                                                                                                                        Your data that was within the free limits (kept channel, up to 100 scheduled messages, one recurring message) is never removed, so nothing you kept is lost.

                                                                                                                                                                          Refunds

                                                                                                                                                                          Premium

                                                                                                                                                                          Premium is paid in Telegram Stars, and Stars purchases are final under Telegram's own rules. Outside mandatory consumer rights, refunds are discretionary and granted case by case — typically for a double charge or a technical fault on our side.

                                                                                                                                                                          To request a refund, email fastschedulebot@gmail.com with:
                                                                                                                                                                          • The transaction ID (in the Stars payment confirmation or Settings → Payments).
                                                                                                                                                                          • Your Telegram username.
                                                                                                                                                                          • The purchase date and a short reason.

                                                                                                                                                                          We acknowledge requests within 7 business days. Approved refunds return through Telegram only; referral days and promo free periods have no monetary value and are never refundable.

                                                                                                                                                                          To stop future billing on a monthly plan, cancel via /premium — the paid period stays active until its end date.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Is Fast Scheduler Premium Worth It? An Honest Breakdown

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium costs $6.83 a month (or $68.03 a year) and removes the ceiling on almost everything Free limits. Here is an honest map of who needs which part.

                                                                                                                                                                                      What Premium changes, concretely

                                                                                                                                                                                      • 3 channels, 3 sender bots — run a network (main channel, announcements, chat-announcements mirror) from one account.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Unlimited scheduled queue and unlimited sends — no 100-post queue, no monthly cap on any channel.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Unlimited recurring rules — and they never expire; Free's single rule stops after 365 days.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Bigger media: uploads to 100 MB, video to up to 50MB, 20 storage boxes with 500 items total and video allowed, plus 4K-photo handling and higher bitrate media that Free compresses harder.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Signatures — a footer (credit, promo, hashtags) auto-appended to every post of a channel.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Export & Backup toolkit — .fsback/.fspback backups, JSON/CSV/TXT/RTF/ODT exports: own your content.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Who does not need it

                                                                                                                                                                                      One channel, a couple of posts a day, no video-heavy content — Free covers that indefinitely. Premium's first meaningful gate for such a setup would be the monthly send cap, and even that takes ~3+ posts/day to hit.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Who feels the difference on day one

                                                                                                                                                                                      • Multi-channel admins — the 3×3 pairing is the headline feature.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Video channels — 25MB → 50MB video and video-in-storage change the workflow.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Anyone whose content is their business — backups and full exports are the difference between “my queue” and “my archive”.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Automation lovers — unlimited recurring rules turn the bot into a true publishing engine.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Terms worth knowing

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium attaches to your Telegram account, covers all your channels at once, and can be paid with Telegram Stars. Multi-month terms cost less per month (3/6-month discounts), and if something goes wrong the refund policy is linked in the footer — premium status is visible any time with /premium.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                      Does Premium apply to all my channels or per channel?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Per account. One subscription unlocks the higher limits for every channel you connect while it is active.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Buy Premium
                                                                                                                                                                                      What happens to my schedules when Premium expires?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Nothing is deleted. Limits revert to Free: extra channels/bots beyond 1×1 stop scheduling until you disconnect them or renew, the queue cap applies again, and recurring rules beyond the first pause.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium Expiry
                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I pay with Telegram Stars?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Yes — Stars are billed at the official rate and are currently the only payment method. The Premium menu always shows current prices.

                                                                                                                                                                                      How to Pay for Fast Scheduler Premium (Stars and What Happens After)

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium attaches to your Telegram account and covers every channel you connect while it is active. Payment lives in the bot's Premium menu and uses Telegram Stars only.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Telegram Stars

                                                                                                                                                                                      Stars are Telegram's in-app currency. The bot converts the USD price at the official rate and shows the exact Star amount before you confirm — buy Stars in Telegram if your balance is short, approve, and Premium activates the moment the invoice clears. Refunds of Stars purchases follow Telegram's own flow, which is also why the bot asks you to double-check the term before paying.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Plan terms

                                                                                                                                                                                      The monthly Stars plan renews automatically until cancelled. Prepaid 3-month, 6-month, and yearly plans are one-time purchases (with up-front 3/6-month discounts) and never auto-renew.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Right after payment

                                                                                                                                                                                      • Premium flags appear instantly in the menus; /premium shows status and expiry date.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • If you paid but see no change: restart the bot with /start — status is refreshed on launch. Still stuck? /feedback with the payment date and method gets a human on it the same day.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Terms, renewals, refunds

                                                                                                                                                                                      Multi-month terms cost proportionally less (built-in 3/6-month discounts), and expiry is shown everywhere Premium matters. When a prepaid term ends, limits quietly return to Free — nothing is deleted. The refund policy is linked in the site footer; genuine failures (double payment, activation glitch) are refunded by support.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I pay for a friend’s account?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium binds to the Telegram account that activates it. To gift Premium, have them open the Premium menu and pay there, or transfer Stars — the bot cannot attach Premium to a different account after payment.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Buy Premium
                                                                                                                                                                                      Will Premium renew automatically?

                                                                                                                                                                                      The monthly Stars plan renews automatically until cancelled. Prepaid 3-month, 6-month, and yearly plans never auto-renew — when one ends, limits revert to Free and you can extend any time from the Premium menu.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium Expiry

                                                                                                                                                                                      Free vs Premium: Which Fast Scheduler Plan Fits Your Channel?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                      Feature tables tell you what differs; this tells you when it matters. Four questions decide the plan.

                                                                                                                                                                                      1. How many channels do you run?

                                                                                                                                                                                      One channel works great on Free (1 channel, 1 sender bot). Two or three channels — or plans to get there — is the cleanest Premium trigger: Premium pairs 3 channels with 3 sender bots from one account.

                                                                                                                                                                                      2. How much do you post?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Multiply daily posts by 30. Under ~90 sends/month, Free's 100-per-channel cap rarely bites. A 3+/day cadence, or channels where every send counts (news, trading, drops), wants Premium's unlimited sends and queue.

                                                                                                                                                                                      3. Is your content video-heavy?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Free uploads top out at 10 MB with video at up to 25MB, no video in Media Storage, and stronger compression. If your posts live on video, Premium's 100 MB uploads, up to 50MB video, and video-in-storage are not a luxury — they are the workflow.

                                                                                                                                                                                      4. Do you need backups, exports or signatures?

                                                                                                                                                                                      The Export & Backup toolkit (.fsback archives, JSON/CSV exports) and auto-signatures are Premium-only. If the queue is your business — client channels, monetized content — backups stop being optional the first time you restructure a month of posts.

                                                                                                                                                                                      The short version

                                                                                                                                                                                      • Stay Free if: one channel, ≤3 posts/day, text-and-photo content, no archive needs.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Go Premium if: 2–3 channels, 3+ posts/day, video content, recurring automation beyond one rule, or you want backups and signatures.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Either way: you can start Free and upgrade the moment a limit touches you — nothing you built on Free breaks when Premium ends.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I try Premium and go back to Free?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Yes. On expiry, limits revert to Free and nothing is deleted — disconnect extra channels if you keep more than one, and the first recurring rule keeps running.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium Expiry
                                                                                                                                                                                      Does Premium change how fast posts send?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Send speed is the same — Telegram delivery does not differ by plan. Premium removes quantity limits and media compression, not latency.

                                                                                                                                                                                      How Do I Get a Refund on My Fast Scheduler Premium Purchase?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                      Refunds are handled personally, not by a faceless form. If a purchase went wrong — a double charge, an accidental renewal, Premium that never activated — you write one email and a human sorts it out. Here is the whole procedure, step by step.

                                                                                                                                                                                      What to send

                                                                                                                                                                                      Email fastschedulebot@gmail.com with three things:

                                                                                                                                                                                      • Your transaction ID — Telegram shows it in the Stars payment confirmation and in Settings → Payments.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • Your Telegram username (or user ID) so the purchase can be matched to your account.
                                                                                                                                                                                      • The reason — one honest sentence is enough, plus the purchase date and the account or email used, where applicable.

                                                                                                                                                                                      The 30-day window and what happens next

                                                                                                                                                                                      Refund requests are accepted within 30 days of the charge. Requests are acknowledged within 7 business days, and approved refunds are returned through the original payment method — for Telegram Stars that means back to your Stars balance. Refunds are discretionary rather than guaranteed for every situation, which is exactly why a short, honest reason helps: accidental purchases and technical failures the team could not fix are the classic approved cases.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Cancelling so you are not charged again

                                                                                                                                                                                      Monthly Stars plans renew automatically until cancelled. You cancel inside the bot: open /premium → ❌ Cancel Premium. Cancelling stops future billing; the period you already paid for stays active until its end date, and Premium switches off at that boundary rather than mid-plan. The 3-month, 6-month and yearly packs are one-time purchases — they simply expire and never auto-charge.

                                                                                                                                                                                      What not to do: chargebacks

                                                                                                                                                                                      Opening a card or Apple/Google chargeback instead of emailing is treated as abuse: the account loses Premium immediately and the subscription fee is forfeited. Emailing first is always faster — most refund conversations end within a couple of messages.

                                                                                                                                                                                      One more nuance: deleting your data or stopping use of the bot does not automatically refund anything, so if you want both, request the refund before asking for account deletion.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                      How long does a Fast Scheduler refund take?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Requests are acknowledged within 7 business days. Once approved, Stars refunds return to your Telegram Stars balance; the total time depends on Telegram, typically a few days.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Buy Premium
                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I cancel Premium and keep it until the period ends?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Yes. Cancelling via /premium stops auto-renewal, and Premium stays active until the end of the paid period. Downgrade happens at that boundary, not immediately.

                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium
                                                                                                                                                                                      I was charged twice. What do I do?

                                                                                                                                                                                      Email fastschedulebot@gmail.com with both transaction IDs and your Telegram username. Duplicate charges are the clearest refund case and are resolved quickly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                            Help CenterReferralsWhy Verification Is Required

                                                                                                                                                                                                            Why Verification Is Required

                                                                                                                                                                                                            Referrals

                                                                                                                                                                                                            To unlock the Referral Program you must connect a channel and schedule at least 1 message. This is not bureaucracy — it is how we verify your account is real.

                                                                                                                                                                                                            Why we do it. Every referral reward is paid out as Premium time, and Premium time costs us real money (Telegram Stars fees and server costs). Without verification, anyone could spin up dozens of empty accounts in minutes and drain the reward pool — which would force us to shut the program down for everyone, including honest users.

                                                                                                                                                                                                            What counts as verification. Connecting a channel proves you have something real to post to; scheduling a message proves you actually use the bot. Both checks are automatic and take most users under two minutes: send your channel link in Step 1 of the tutorial, then schedule any post — even a test message to yourself counts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                            What we check — and what we don't. We only look at anonymous counters (channels connected, messages created). We never read your message contents, never ask for documents or phone numbers, and never share anything with third parties. Verification is purely about activity, not identity.

                                                                                                                                                                                                            Common confusion. Opening the Referral menu before verifying shows a locked screen — that is expected, not a bug. Finish the two steps above and the menu unlocks by itself; nothing else is required.

                                                                                                                                                                                                              Help CenterReferralsBeta Program

                                                                                                                                                                                                              Beta Program

                                                                                                                                                                                                              Referrals

                                                                                                                                                                                                              The Referral Program is currently in BETA. It works end to end — links, tracking, crediting and day activation are all live — but you may occasionally run into rough edges: a counter that updates with a delay, a list that needs a reopen to refresh, or a message that reads slightly differently from what you expected.

                                                                                                                                                                                                              Your earned days are safe. Beta status affects polish, never balances. Every qualifying referral is recorded the moment it happens, and Premium days, once earned, are never lost because of a display glitch. If something looks wrong, reopen the /referral menu first — most counters refresh on open.

                                                                                                                                                                                                              Help us finish it. If you spot an error, tell us through /feedback with what you did step by step and, if possible, a screenshot. Beta reporters directly shape the final version: unclear texts get rewritten and confusing flows get simplified because of your reports.

                                                                                                                                                                                                              What may change. Reward sizes, limits and rules can still be tuned while the program is in beta. Any change will be announced in the referral menu itself — earned balances are always honored under the rules that were live when they were earned.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Help CenterReferralsHow Crediting Works

                                                                                                                                                                                                                How Crediting Works

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Referrals

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Here is exactly what happens from click to Premium days, for both sides.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. Click. A new user opens your link and starts the bot. The click is recorded instantly, but nothing is granted yet — this is what the "pending" state in your list means.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. Verify. The new user connects a channel and schedules at least 1 message — the same verification you completed to unlock the program. Until then, the referral stays pending.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                3. Credit. The moment they qualify, both of you receive 3 Premium days: the days land in your referral balance (see them with /referral under Available days). If you already have paid Premium, the days wait in your balance until it ends.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                4. Activate. On the free plan, activate earned days from the referral menu — a Premium period starts immediately. Used days move to the Used counter so you always see earned, used and available totals.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Limits. Each user can generate referral rewards from up to 15 referees, i.e. a 45-day total. One referral per user — the same newcomer can never credit you twice, even if they click your link again.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Help CenterLimits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Limits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Limits1 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Fast Scheduler's plans differ in five numbers: pending scheduled messages, sends per month, recurring messages, channels, and sender bots. The bot counts them live — /stats always shows your current usage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Free: 100 pending messages, 100 sends per channel per month, 1 recurring message, 1 channel, 1 sender bot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Premium: unlimited pending and sent messages, unlimited recurring messages, 3 channels, 3 bots, plus larger media storage and longer videos.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  There is no daily cap on either plan — the only send quota on Free is monthly, and it resets on the 1st.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  How do I check my current usage?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use /stats to see your real-time usage against plan limits.
