                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What Do I Get With Fast Scheduler for Free? (Exact Limits)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Limits3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Free is a real plan, not a trial — it never expires and has no daily caps. Here is exactly what you get, with numbers you can plan around.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The numbers

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 1 channel with 1 sender bot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Up to 100 scheduled messages pending at once — your working queue. As posts go out, space frees up; this is not a monthly allowance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 100 sent messages per channel per calendar month — the actual sending quota. Resets on the 1st.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 1 recurring message — one repeating rule (daily, weekly, every N hours…). Recurring rules on Free expire after 365 days and need re-confirming.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Media Storage: 1 box with 100 items, no video in storage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Uploads up to 10 MB, videos up to 25MB.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What “100/month per channel” means in practice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                If you post 3 times a day, that is ~90 posts a month — Free covers a light daily cadence on one channel. Posting 5+ times a day, or running several channels, is where Premium starts to make sense. The counter counts sends by the sender bot; edits, previews and deleted schedules are free.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                There is no daily cap

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Older versions of the bot had daily limits; they are gone. On Free you can schedule and send every single day — the only quotas are the pending-queue size and the monthly send count. Check both any time with /stats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Hitting a limit gracefully

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The queue limit blocks new schedules, never deletes old ones; the monthly cap pauses sends until the 1st (the bot tells you). Both warn you in advance with clear messages and a one-tap upgrade path. Nothing is silently dropped.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Do unused sends carry over to next month?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                No. The monthly counter resets to zero on the 1st; unused sends do not roll over. The pending-queue space is also not a quota to “use up” — it just caps how far ahead you can stockpile.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Monthly Send Limit
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Is the free plan time-limited or feature-crippled?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                It never expires. Scheduling, recurring, statistics, search and the calendar all work on Free. Premium removes quantity limits and adds the Export/Backup toolkit, signatures and bigger media.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Premium
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                How do I check my current usage?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Send /stats. It shows your queue size, monthly sends, recurring rules and storage at a glance.

Time Zones, Explained Simply

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Why Did My Post Go Out at the Wrong Time? Time Zones, Explained Simply

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Time Zone2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      “I scheduled 9:00 and it posted at 12:00” — before anything else, check which clock the number 9:00 belongs to. Fast Scheduler schedules posts in a time zone, and the zone that matters is the one set for the channel, not the one on your watch.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      How the bot decides “when 9:00 is”

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Every channel has a time zone setting. When you schedule 9:00, the bot stores 9:00 in the channel's zone and converts it to UTC behind the scenes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If the zone is UTC (the default) and you are in, say, New York, your 9:00 local is 13:00 or 14:00 UTC — the post will “move” by 4–5 hours from your point of view.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Set the channel's zone to your own city once, and from then on 9:00 means your 9:00, every time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The daylight-saving trap

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Zones that observe DST shift twice a year. A post scheduled for 9:00 in March may land at 8:00 or 10:00 relative to the wall clock in November, depending on how the zone handles the shift. If your audience notices a one-hour drift in spring or autumn, that is why. The schedule did not break — the zone's definition of 9:00 changed. Reschedule around the shift week if you post at a strict local hour.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Checking and fixing the zone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Open Time Zone in the bot (or /timezone), pick the channel, and choose the city/zone that matches your audience — the list uses proper zone names like Europe/Berlin, so DST is handled by the same rules your phone uses. Upcoming posts keep their stored times; only new schedules use the new zone, so double-check anything queued for the same day you change it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Quick diagnosis table

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Off by a whole number of hours, constant — wrong zone set for the channel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Off by one hour, only in spring/autumn — DST shift; the zone is working correctly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Off by a few minutes, growing over weeks — rare; send /feedback with two examples.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Does changing the time zone move my scheduled posts?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      No. Existing posts keep their stored times; the new zone applies to schedules you create afterwards. Verify the next few posts after changing the zone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Set Time Zone
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What time zone should I pick for an international audience?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Pick the zone of your largest audience segment, or UTC if you think in UTC. Consistency matters more than the specific zone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Help CenterTime ZoneWhy Was My Scheduled Telegram Post Published at the Wrong Time?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Why Was My Scheduled Telegram Post Published at the Wrong Time?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Time Zone2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When a scheduled message fires at an unexpected hour, the clock itself is almost never wrong — the time zone used to interpret “9:00” is. Fast Scheduler resolves every time through two settings, and a mismatch between them explains nearly every “wrong time” report.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The two clocks: user time zone and channel time zone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Your user time zone — set once via /timezone and used whenever you type a time into the scheduling conversation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Each channel’s own time zone — set per channel, because the audience that reads the channel may live in a different zone than you do. Schedules for that channel are interpreted in the channel’s zone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If your user zone says UTC+3 but the channel zone says UTC+0, a message you schedule for 9:00 is stored as 9:00 channel time — and lands six hours earlier than you visually expected. Check both: /timezone for yourself, and the channel settings inside the bot for the channel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Daylight saving time

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Zones with DST shift by one hour twice a year. Fast Scheduler stores schedules in absolute terms, so a post that crossed a DST boundary can appear to “move” by an hour. If you live in a DST zone and noticed the shift right after the clocks changed, re-check the channel’s zone — picking a zone like Europe/Berlin (which follows DST rules) versus a fixed UTC offset produces different results across the year.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Quick diagnosis checklist

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Off by a round number of hours (3, 4, 6…) → time-zone mismatch; fix the channel time zone or your user zone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Off by exactly one hour right after late March / late October → DST; confirm the zone uses the right convention.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • AM/PM confusion — schedule with the 24-hour clock (14:00, not 2:00) to remove ambiguity entirely.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Around midnight — double-check you scheduled the day you meant; the date picker always shows the resolved local date and time for final confirmation before saving.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      One more tip: the confirmation screen before saving shows the exact send time. Reading that single line — not the input you typed — is the ground truth for when the post will fire.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Does each Telegram channel have its own time zone in Fast Scheduler?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Yes. Every channel carries its own time zone, and schedules for that channel are interpreted in the channel zone. Your personal /timezone setting applies to how you enter times while chatting with the bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Set Time ZoneSupported Zones
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      How do I change the time zone of a channel?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Open the bot, go to the channel settings, and set its time zone there. Existing scheduled messages keep their stored times, so new schedules pick up the change immediately.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Language

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Language2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      How do I disable language sync?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Go to Language on the main menu → tap Disable Language Sync. This stops cross-bot sync offers between Fast Scheduler and @SetDate_bot, and turns off Telegram language detection. You can re-enable it anytime from the same menu.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      How do I hide language sync notifications?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Premium feature. Go to Language on the main menu → tap Hide Notifications. Sync still works but you won't see the notification popups. Toggle it back to show notifications again.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Help CenterLanguageMissing Language?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Missing Language?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Language

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The bot ships in several languages, and English is always available. If yours isn't in the list yet:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Check the full list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Open Language (or /language) and scroll — the menu shows every currently supported language, and new ones are added over time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Request a translation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Ask via Feedback in the bot or write to @MaximalXP and tell us which language you need. Popular requests get prioritised.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            In the meantime
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • English commands like /schedule and /list work no matter which language is active.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Your channel content is never translated — only the bot's interface language changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • @SetDate_bot shares your language preference, so both bots switch together once your language is added.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Import2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I import messages in bulk?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes! Send a .txt file where each message is separated by a blank line. All messages will be imported with the same date/time. You can then edit each one individually.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What formats are supported for import?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Supported formats: .txt, .csv, .json, .rtf, .odt, .fsback (full backup), .fspback (password-protected backup).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Importing Your Data

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Import

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Import brings messages back into the scheduler from a file — the mirror image of Export.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  How to import
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. Open Data → Import (or send /import).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. Send the file: a .fsback/.fspback backup, a .txt message list, a .csv spreadsheet, or a SetDate schedule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. For password-protected backups, enter the password when asked.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  4. Confirm — full backups restore with an Overwrite or Add choice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Two kinds of import
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Backup restore (from your own /backup files): everything comes back — scheduled and recurring messages, settings, channels, bots, media boxes. Overwrite replaces the current data; Add merges on top of it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Message lists (.txt / .csv / SetDate): each block or row becomes a scheduled message in your connected channel, so make sure the channel is connected before you start.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Before you confirm
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A full restore with Overwrite replaces your current data. If in doubt, run /export first (Premium) so you always have a way back.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Import From Storage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Import

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When building schedules in SetDate or bulk import, you can attach media from your storage library.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      In the import flow, pick media from storage to attach to imported messages - useful when your spreadsheet references file names that exist in your storage boxes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      This keeps your content consistent without re-uploading files.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Help CenterImportCSV Import

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CSV Import

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Import

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CSV import turns a spreadsheet into scheduled messages — perfect for content plans prepared in Excel or Google Sheets.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The format
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The file needs two columns: Date/Time and Content. Export your sheet as CSV (UTF-8) and send it to the bot during the import flow. Each row becomes one scheduled message; the date column accepts the same formats the bot accepts when typing (for example 25.12.2025 10:00).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Where messages land
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Rows are imported into your connected channel — the import targets it directly, there is no channel picker. Times are interpreted in the channel's time zone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Tips for clean imports
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Keep one message per row; put line breaks inside the Content cell.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Test with a two-row file first, review the result in the Message List, then import the full sheet.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Need richer structure (multiple channels, media)? Use .txt blocks or a full backup restore instead.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          JSON Import

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Import

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          JSON import restores structured exports — including the exports made by this bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Send the .json file during the import flow (Data → Import, or /import). The bot reads each record and recreates the scheduled message: text, date, and channel reference. If the file was exported from a different setup, messages land in your currently connected channel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Prefer a complete snapshot restore — settings, bots, recurring messages and all? A .fsback backup restore is the right tool; JSON is for message-level transfers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Supported Import Formats

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Import

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The import flow accepts:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • .fsback / .fspback — full bot backups (restore with Overwrite or Add).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • .txt — message lists; a blank line starts a new message, with the date on its own line (see the Format topic).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • .csv — spreadsheets with Date/Time and Content columns.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • SetDate files — schedules generated by @SetDate_bot, imported as-is.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • .json — structured exports.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Everything except full backups imports into your connected channel, in the channel's time zone. Connect the channel first, then import.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Backup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Backup6 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              How do I export my data?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Step by step:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. Click Export on the main menu (page 2) or use /export
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. Choose what to export: Scheduled Messages, Recurring Messages, or Media Storage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. Choose format:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • .txt — plain text, human-readable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • .csv — spreadsheet (opens in Excel/Google Sheets)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • .json — structured data for developers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. The file is sent to you as a document

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              For a full backup (Premium): use /backup → choose password protection (optional) → the .fsback file is sent to you. To restore: use /import and send the .fsback file.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              How do I restore a backup?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Step by step:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. Click Import on the main menu (page 2) or use /import
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. Send the backup file (.fsback or .fspback)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. If password-protected, enter the password when prompted
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. The bot restores all your data — messages, channels, bots, settings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              5. You'll get a confirmation when done

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Note: Restoring a backup replaces your current data. Make sure to export your current data first if you want to keep it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Can I set up automatic backups?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Automatic backups are not available as a built-in feature yet. However, you can manually export anytime:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Use /export for selective export (scheduled, recurring, or media)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Use /backup for a full backup (Premium, can be password-protected)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Recommendation: export your data regularly, especially before making big changes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              How do I create a password-protected backup?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Premium feature. Step by step:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. Use /backup command
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. When prompted, choose Enable Password Protection
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. Enter a password (you'll need this to restore later — don't forget it!)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. The .fspback file is generated and sent to you
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              5. To restore: use /import → send the .fspback file → enter the password

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Warning: Without the password, the backup cannot be restored. Keep your password safe!

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What's included in a full backup?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A full backup (.fsback / .fspback) includes: all scheduled messages (text, media, settings), all recurring messages, media storage items and boxes, channel connections and settings, bot tokens and assignments, user preferences (language, timezone), and referral data. Everything needed to restore your account to exactly the same state.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What's the difference between .fsback and .fspback?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              .fsback is a standard full backup (no password). .fspback is a password-protected backup with encryption (Premium only). Both contain the same data, but .fspback requires a password to restore. To create a .fspback: use /backup → choose password protection → enter your password.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  What Is Backed Up

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Backup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A full backup includes:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Scheduled and recurring messages (content, times, media refs)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Connected channels and sender bot assignments
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Settings (language, time zone, signatures)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Media storage items and boxes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Referral and promo data

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Basically everything needed to restore the same account.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What Is Excluded

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Backup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A backup does not include:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Files/media binary themselves for large uploads are re-verified on restore where needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Data of other users.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Server logs or internal state.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If something can't be included, the backup report tells you.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Backup Password

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Backup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Protect your backup with a password (/backup → enable password).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The file becomes encrypted (.fspback) and requires the password to restore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Warning: without the password, the backup cannot be restored. Store it somewhere you won't lose it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Backup Size

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Backup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Backup file size depends on your data volume: number of messages, media references, and settings.

Media is stored as references (files are re-uploaded), keeping the backup compact.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Scheduled Backups

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Backup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Automatic recurring backups aren't a feature yet.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Instead, export regularly yourself:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • /backup for a full snapshot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • /export for quick selective exports.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A good habit: backup before big changes or after major campaigns.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Backup
