                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Help CenterBackupWhat Is the Difference Between .fsback and .fspback?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What Is the Difference Between .fsback and .fspback?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Backup4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Short answer: both are the same complete backup — the only difference is the password. A .fspback file is a password-protected .fsback file. The extra “p” stands for protected.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What each format is

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • .fsback — a full backup of your Fast Scheduler data with no password. Anyone who gets the file can restore it, so treat it like a plain-text secret.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • .fspback — the same backup, encrypted. Restoring asks for the password you set when creating it. Without the password the data inside cannot be read.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When you tap Create Backup (or send /backup), the bot asks whether you want password protection. Choosing no password produces .fsback; setting a password (and an optional hint) produces .fspback. A Premium feature — backups are part of the Export & Backup toolkit that unlocks with Premium.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What is inside either file

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Both formats package your selected data — scheduled messages, recurring messages, settings, and more — into one archive you can download, store in the cloud, or move to another account. Media you saved in Media Storage is referenced, not re-uploaded, so files stay small.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Which one should you pick?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Restoring to your own account right now? .fsback is fine and faster to use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Keeping the file long-term, sending it to a teammate, or migrating to a new phone? .fspback — the password protects your scheduled content from strangers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Restoring a file

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Send /import to the bot, attach the .fsback or .fspback file, enter the password if asked, then choose Overwrite (replace current data) or Add (merge with current data). Export a fresh backup before you overwrite anything.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Is .fspback more secure than .fsback?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes. A .fspback file is encrypted with the password you set; a .fsback file is not protected at all. If the backup contains bot tokens or private content, prefer .fspback.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Backup Password
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I lost the password to my .fspback file. Can it be recovered?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No. The password cannot be reset or bypassed — not even by support. Keep the password (and the hint you optionally set) together with the file. Without it the backup is unreadable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Restore Backup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I convert .fsback to .fspback (or back)?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Indirectly: restore the .fsback file into your account, then create a new backup and choose password protection to get a .fspback file. There is no direct file-conversion command.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Create Backup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Which formats can I import besides these?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Imports also accept .json, .csv, .txt, .rtf and .odt files (and SetDate bundles). Those carry messages only, while .fsback/.fspback carry your full configuration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Help CenterBackupHow to Back Up All Scheduled Posts in Telegram (and Restore Them Anywhere)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How to Back Up All Scheduled Posts in Telegram (and Restore Them Anywhere)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Backup4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Rebuilding a month of scheduled posts by hand is nobody's idea of fun. Fast Scheduler's backup system exists so you never have to: one file captures everything, and restoring it on any account takes about a minute.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What a backup contains

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A .fsback / .fspback file packages the parts of your account you select — typically:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Scheduled messages — every queued post with its exact send time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Recurring messages — repeat rules (daily, weekly, custom intervals) and their expiry settings.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Settings — language, time zone, signatures, channel preferences.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Media Storage references — saved photos, videos and documents with their boxes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What is not included: user backups exclude sender-bot tokens, and payment history never leaves Telegram's systems. The export screen lets you review what goes into the file before you confirm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Creating a backup — step by step

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Backups are a Premium feature. With Premium active:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 1. Open the menu → Data → Export (or send /backup).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 2. Pick what to include (scheduled, recurring, all).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 3. Choose password protection: none for .fsback, or set a password + hint for .fspback.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 4. The bot packs the archive and sends the file. Save it somewhere real — cloud drive, local disk, anywhere that survives losing your phone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Restoring — the safe way

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Send /import, attach the file, enter the password if prompted. The bot then asks how to apply it:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Overwrite — replaces your current data with the backup's content. Anything not in the backup disappears.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Add — merges the backup into your current data, keeping what you already have.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Golden rule: export a fresh backup before restoring an older one. It is your undo button if the result surprises you.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Good backup habits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Take a fresh backup before deleting a channel, rotating a bot, or bulk-editing posts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Keep at least one .fspback with a strong password — shared drives get opened by more people than you think.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • After switching phones or accounts, restore + verify the Message List before the real posting week starts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Is backup free or Premium?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Creating .fsback/.fspback backups is part of the Export & Backup toolkit, which requires Premium. Importing files (/import) works on Free, so anyone can restore a backup received from someone else.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Buy Premium
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Where should I store the backup file?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Anywhere outside Telegram: a cloud drive, your computer, or an encrypted notes app. Telegram keeps the file in your chat too, but Saved Messages is not a backup strategy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Download
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How big is a backup file?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Small — usually kilobytes to a few megabytes, because media is referenced rather than embedded. Text and schedules compress extremely well.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Backup Size
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I move my schedules to another Telegram account?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes. Create a backup on the old account, log into the new one, connect the channel and a sender bot, then restore the backup with Add mode. This is the standard migration path.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Migration FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Media Storage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Media Storage8 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How do I create a storage box and save media?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Step by step:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. Click Media Storage on the main menu (page 2) or use /storage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. Click Create Box
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. Enter a name for your box (e.g., "Product Photos")
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. The box is created — now click on it to open it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    5. Send photos, videos, or files to the bot — they'll be saved in this box
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    6. Later, when scheduling a message, choose From Storage as the media option and pick from your collection

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Free plan: 1 box, max 100 items, no videos. Premium: up to 20 boxes, 500 items.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How do I rename or delete a storage box?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    To rename: click Media Storage → select the box → click Rename → type the new name → confirm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    To delete: click Media Storage → select the box → click Delete Box → confirm deletion. Warning: Deleting a box removes ALL media inside it permanently.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I move items between storage boxes?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes — bulk move and copy is a Premium feature. Step by step:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. Click Media Storage → open the source box
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. Use Move All or Copy All (optionally filtered by type: images, videos, files)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. Choose the destination box from the list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. The items are moved/copied — no need to re-upload

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    On the Free plan you can move or copy one file at a time instead — open the item and use Move / Copy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    This helps you reorganize your media collection without re-uploading anything.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I download a whole storage box?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes — box download is a Premium feature: open the box and tap Download Box to get its files as an archive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    On the Free plan open any item and tap Download to save files one at a time, without compression.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What happens to my storage when Premium expires?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    On the first day after expiry, you'll get a prompt to choose 1 storage box to keep. If you don't choose, the newest box is kept by default. Excess boxes are deleted after 17 days. The kept box is trimmed to the newest 100 items (videos are removed first, oldest first). To avoid this: reactivate Premium with /premium before day 17.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Premium ExpiryFrozen Assets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I store videos in Media Storage?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Free plan: No in storage — you'll get an error if you try. Premium: up to 50MB per video. Videos larger than the premium limit cannot be saved to storage even on Premium. To check your plan: use /premium or click Premium on the main menu.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Limits
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How do I delete individual items from storage?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Step by step:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. Click Media Storage on the main menu (or use /storage)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. Select the storage box containing the items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. Browse the list of media items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. Click on an item → click Delete
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    5. Confirm deletion — this is permanent and cannot be undone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    To delete everything: use Delete Box to remove the entire box and all contents.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I preview media before selecting it for a message?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes! When scheduling a message and you reach the media step:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. Choose From Storage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. Select a storage box
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. Each item shows a preview — you can see the image/video before picking it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. Click on the one you want → it's attached to your scheduled message
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    5. Confirm and your message is ready with the selected media

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When to Use Storage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Media Storage1 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Use media storage when you:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Post the same photos/videos repeatedly (products, headers, promos).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Want consistent branding across posts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Build schedules in bulk and need media without re-uploading.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      For one-off posts, just attach media directly during scheduling.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When is media storage useful?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Whenever you reuse visuals — promo banners, cover images, or recurring content. Save once, then attach to any scheduled message without re-uploading.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Storage Boxes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Media Storage1 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Your media is organized into boxes (storages). Each box holds photos, videos, and documents you can reuse in schedules.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Free plan: 1 box up to 100 items. Premium: up to 20 boxes, 500 items total.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Open Storage from the main menu to see your boxes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How do I create a storage box?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Open Media Storage, tap Create Box, give it a name, then save media into it directly from the schedule flow. Free plan allows 1 (max 100) box.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Create a Box

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Media Storage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A box is your reusable media library. Fill one with photos, videos or files, then pick From Storage while scheduling and the bot attaches media for you — even randomly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How to create:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1. Open Storage from the main menu.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2. Tap ➕ Add Storage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3. Give the box a name and send it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Free: 1 box. Premium: up to 20 boxes — great for organizing media by campaign, product, or channel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Manage Storage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Media Storage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        All storage actions are available from Storage in the main menu:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Create/rename/delete boxes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Upload, preview, copy, move, replace, and delete items.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Premium bulk tools inside an open box: Move All, Copy All (optionally filtered by type) and Download Box for the whole box as an archive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Items are kept until you delete them. If Premium lapses, the expiry cleanup may remove excess media.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Storage Limits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Media Storage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Free: 1 box, up to 100 items total, no videos in storage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Premium: up to 20 boxes, 500 items total, videos allowed (up to 50MB).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          When you upgrade/downgrade, your saved media is kept; if your plan is reduced, storage beyond the free quota is handled during the expiry process.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Storage on Premium

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Media Storage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Premium storage benefits:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 20 boxes instead of 1, with up to 500 items total.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Videos allowed in storage (up to 50MB).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Max media size (100 MB).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Move All / Copy All — reorganize a whole box in one tap, optionally filtered by type (images, videos, files).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Download Box — save an entire box as a single archive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            On Free you can still move, copy, and download items one at a time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Upgrade via /premium to unlock them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Media Compression & Retention

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Media Storage3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              All media you send to the bot is automatically compressed &mdash; this shrinks the file Telegram stores and sends, and keeps it within your plan's size limits.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Compression Comparison

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Compression is applied automatically when you upload media to: Media Storage, Scheduled / Recurring messages, Feedback attachments, Broadcasts, and anywhere else in the bot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Documents and stickers are stored as-is without compression.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Media Retention & Cleanup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The bot periodically removes old media references that are no longer needed:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Ratings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Admin reply media in rating reviews: deleted after 30 days
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The rating (stars, review text) stays forever

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Feedback / Support tickets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Attachments in closed / spam tickets: deleted after 30 days from closure
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The conversation text stays forever

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Media Storage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Items are kept until you delete them manually
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Never auto-deleted

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Scheduled Messages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Media reference is removed immediately after the message is sent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No data lingers

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Recurring Messages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Media stays until you delete the recurring message
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Free accounts: recurring message expires after 1 year and is auto-removed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              FeatureFreePremium
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Photo max1600px2500px
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Photo qualityQ65Q90
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Video max620p1080p
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Video CRF2823
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Video bitrate1Mbps2Mbps
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Audio bitrate64k128k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4K mediaBlockedAllowed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Is my media quality reduced?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Yes. All photos, videos, audio files, and voice messages are compressed to save Telegram server storage. Free users get aggressive compression (photos 1600px/Q65, video 620p/CRF28, audio 64k). Premium users get gentler compression (photos 2500px/Q90, video 1080p/CRF23, audio 128k). On a phone screen the difference is barely noticeable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Free users are also blocked from uploading 4K media (photos ≥3840px or videos ≥2160p). Upgrade to Premium to send high-resolution content.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              How much smaller will my files get?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Typical savings depend on the original file:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Photos: free 60–85%, premium 30–50%
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Videos: varies by source; a 50MB video at 1080p can drop to ~5–8MB for free users or ~15–25MB for premium users
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Audio/Voice: re-encoded at the target bitrate, so a 320kbps file at 10MB would become ~2MB (free 64k) or ~4MB (premium 128k)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Can I get my original uncompressed file back?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              No. Once the bot compresses a file, only the compressed version is stored. Always keep your original files safe on your own device.
