                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Lifecycle

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Media Storage1 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Storage items persist until you delete them. When Premium expires, non-kept boxes are deleted on day 17 and the kept box is trimmed to 100 items (videos first).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Renew Premium before day 17 to keep all media.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What happens to storage boxes on expiry?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                You keep one box you choose. Day 17: other boxes are deleted and your kept box is trimmed to 100 items. Renew before then to keep everything.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Bulk Move, Copy & Box Download

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Media Storage3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Reorganizing a box item by item is slow. Premium adds three bulk tools inside any open box:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Move All
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Moves every item (or only one type: images, videos, files) into a box you pick.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use it to split a mixed box by type or to retire a finished campaign in one tap.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Copy All
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Same flow, but the source box keeps its items — handy for seeding a new campaign box from an archive without touching the original.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Download Box
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Saves the whole box as a single archive, so you can keep an offline copy or hand assets to a teammate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  On Free, open any item and use Move, Copy, or Download for one file at a time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Is bulk move/copy a Premium feature?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Yes — Move All, Copy All, and Download Box need Premium. On Free you can move, copy, or download one file at a time instead.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Can I move only videos or only photos?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Yes. Move All and Copy All offer an optional type filter (images, videos, files), so one tap can split a mixed box by type.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  What do I get when I download a box?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  One archive with the box files, for offline backup or sharing with a teammate. On Free, open items one by one and tap Download instead.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Help CenterMedia StorageWhat Is Media Storage and How Do You Use It Without Losing Your Mind?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What Is Media Storage and How Do You Use It Without Losing Your Mind?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Media Storage2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Media Storage is your in-bot asset library: save a photo, video, or document once, then reuse it in any scheduled post without re-uploading. If you repost evergreen content or reuse brand imagery, this is the feature that saves the most time per week.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Boxes: folders with a purpose

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Assets live in boxes — named containers like “Brand”, “Memes”, “Product shots”. Free gets 1 box with 100 items (no video in storage); Premium gets 20 boxes with 500 items total with video support. Boxes keep the picker fast and your library mentally organized — one box per campaign is a good default.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Saving and reusing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Save: forward or upload media to the storage, or save straight from a scheduled message you are composing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Reuse: while scheduling, open the storage instead of attaching a file — pick the asset, done. Telegram file references are reused, so nothing is re-uploaded and quality is not recompressed per post.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Organize: move items between boxes, rename, delete.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The limits that actually matter

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Item count — the 100-item Free box fills fast with albums; delete stale assets or upgrade.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Video on Free — storage refuses video on Free; schedule videos directly instead, or move to Premium for video-in-storage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Size — same upload caps as messages: 10 MB on Free, 100 MB on Premium.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A cleanup cadence that works

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Once a month: open each box, delete anything unused in 60 days, archive campaign boxes by renaming with a date prefix. Two minutes, and the picker stays a joy instead of an archaeology dig.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does deleting a media item break scheduled posts using it?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Posts keep working — a scheduled message holds its own reference to the media. Deleting from storage only removes it from the library for future posts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Manage Storage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I share a box with another admin?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Storage is per account. To share assets, export them as part of a backup or send the files directly — the other account saves them into their own storage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Tools

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Tools

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Four tools manage everything you schedule:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Message List — the workhorse. Browse messages per channel, preview, edit, delete.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Calendar — the month at a glance; tap a day to see its posts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Search — keyword search across all scheduled and recurring messages.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Statistics — sends, limits, and per-channel counters.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    All four are one tap from the main menu (second page), and each has a matching command: /list, /calendar, /search, /stats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Message List

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Tools

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      View, preview, edit, and delete all your scheduled and recurring messages.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      How to Access:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Click Message List on the main menu or use /list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Pick a channel (if you have multiple)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What You See:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Scheduled messages — shown with date, time, and preview
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Recurring messages — shown with schedule info (daily/weekly/monthly)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Media type — photo, video, document, or text-only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What You Can Do:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Preview — see the full message content and settings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Edit — change text, media, date/time, or channel
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Pause/Resume — temporarily stop a recurring message without deleting it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Delete — remove individual messages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Delete All — remove all messages at once
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Delete by ID — remove a specific job ID

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Pagination:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Messages are shown 10 per page. Use Previous / Next to browse.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      See also: Edit Messages, Delete Messages, and Pause & Resume.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Searching Messages

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Tools1 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The search tool finds any scheduled or recurring message by its text — no scrolling through the calendar needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How to search
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Tap Search on the main menu (second page) or send /search.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2. Type a keyword or phrase.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3. The bot lists every matching scheduled and recurring message with its job ID and send time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        4. Results show job ID and send time — open one and you get the same preview and edit/delete controls as the Message List.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What is searched
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The text content of all scheduled messages.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The text content of all recurring messages.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Job IDs such as s_123 or r_456.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Search is case-insensitive, matches partial words ("hel" finds "hello"), and covers all your messages across every channel at once.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Narrowing results
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use more specific words — the bot matches any of them. To browse by channel or date instead of keyword, the Message List and Calendar tools are the better fit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What if I want to browse all messages?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use Message List to browse messages by channel instead of searching.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Tools

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Find any scheduled or recurring message by keyword.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1. Tap Search (or /search).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Search Scoping & Filters

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Tools

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            While the search box matches any word you type, you can focus results before searching:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Open Search from inside a channel's context (via Bots → a connected bot) to scope results to that channel only.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Combine keywords: the bot finds messages containing any of them, so adding words narrows the practical result set.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Job IDs give an exact match — ideal when you know the ID from a previous preview or notification.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            For everything else — channel-by-channel browsing, month view, per-channel cleanup — the Message List and Calendar remain the fastest tools.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Deleting Found Messages

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Tools

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Every search result opens the same controls as the Message List: preview, edit, and delete.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              To clean up a finished campaign: search for its keyword, walk the results, and delete each message you no longer need. Deletion is permanent — the bot asks for confirmation and shows the removed job ID afterwards.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Need to wipe everything for one channel? Delete All in the Message List removes all scheduled and recurring messages for that channel in one confirmed step — faster than deleting search results one by one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Statistics Dashboard

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tools

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                See your scheduling activity and how your posts perform.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                How to open: tap Statistics on the main menu (page 2) or send /stats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The overview shows:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Scheduled and recurring message counts right now
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Messages sent today and total sent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Messages created in total
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Connected channels

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Per-channel stats: every channel row opens its own view — total messages, average views, comments and reactions, plus the top reactions on your posts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Leaderboards (Premium): from a channel's stats tap Leaderboard — top posts by views, comments or reactions, paginated up to 50 rows per page, filtered by period (today / week / month / year / all). Comment attribution needs the bot in your linked discussion group.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Only posts sent through Fast Scheduler are counted — manually published posts don't appear.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Calendar View

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Tools1 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  See all your scheduled messages on a monthly calendar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  How to Access:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. Click Calendar on the main menu (page 2) or use /calendar
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. Select a channel (if you have multiple)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3. Browse the month — each day shows scheduled send times

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Features:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Navigate between months with Previous / Next buttons
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Both scheduled (one-time) and recurring messages appear
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Recurring messages are expanded across the month based on their schedule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Times are shown in your channel’s timezone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Tips:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use the calendar to spot conflicts or gaps in your schedule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If you don’t see a message, check its timezone setting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For channel-specific views, pick a channel when prompted

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  See also: Timezone Settings and Message List.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  How do I see all my messages in a list?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use Message List for a full list view instead of the calendar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Help CenterToolsHow Can I See Views, Reactions and Comments on My Telegram Channel Posts?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How Can I See Views, Reactions and Comments on My Telegram Channel Posts?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Tools3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Telegram shows view counts under every channel post, but it never shows you trends: which topics overperform, what time of day your audience actually reads, which posts collected the most reactions. Fast Scheduler records the metrics of every post it publishes and turns them into dashboards you can browse in seconds.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Where the numbers live

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Open Statistics on the bot’s main menu (page 2) or send /stats. You get:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Usage totals — lifetime messages sent, messages sent today, and how many schedules and recurring messages are currently active.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Per-channel dashboards — for every connected channel: average views, comments and reactions per post, plus the top reactions your audience uses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Leaderboards (Premium) — your top posts ranked by the metric you pick: Views, Comments, Reactions or Top Commenters. Each board shows 10 entries per page by default (up to 50) and can be filtered by period (day, week, month, year or all time).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What is counted — and what is not

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Statistics are recorded when Fast Scheduler publishes a post and Telegram reports back the post’s metrics. Manually posted content that never passed through the bot is deliberately excluded, so the numbers describe your scheduled content honestly. Comments made in the discussion group under a channel post are picked up too, which is what powers the Comments metric and the Top Commenters board.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Three ways to actually use this

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Find your format. Sort by Views for a month: if the top five posts share a pattern (length, media type, topic), schedule more of it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Time your channel. Compare identical formats posted at different hours, then move recurring messages toward the winning window — the best posting times guide below has the general playbook.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Watch reactions, not just views. Views measure reach; reactions and comments measure resonance. A post with half the views but double the reaction rate is usually the better template.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does Fast Scheduler track posts I publish manually?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No. Only posts published through Fast Scheduler are recorded, which keeps your dashboards focused on your scheduled content strategy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Statistics Dashboard
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Are statistics leaderboards free?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Per-channel averages and usage totals are available to everyone. Leaderboards that rank your top posts by views, comments or reactions are part of Premium.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Premium
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What metrics can leaderboards rank by?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Views, comments, reactions and top commenters — each filterable by day, week, month, year or all time, with up to 50 posts per page.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Backup Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Create a backup regularly — before big changes or when Premium expires (a .fsback file is sent automatically on day 3).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Backup files include your channels, settings, and configured messages.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Store backups somewhere safe — e.g. Saved Messages in Telegram.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use /import to bring everything back on a new device or after reinstalling.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      How often should I make a backup?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Make a backup before big changes and keep the auto-backup you receive when Premium expires (day 3). A backup restores your channels and settings.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Bulk Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Schedule dozens of posts at once by uploading a .txt file — one date+message per block.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Use the same format as the examples: each date line followed by the message keeps them together.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Attach different media to each block, or send texts first and let photos attach in order.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Preview before confirming to catch wrong dates early.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        See Batch Scheduling for the format details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How do I batch-schedule many messages?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Upload a .txt file with date+message blocks (see Batch Scheduling for the exact format). The bot creates one scheduled message per block.
