                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Channel Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Make the bot a channel admin with Post Messages (and Delete Messages for media cleanup).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Use @usernames or invite links when connecting channels.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Set the channel time zone so schedule times match your audience.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • One channel = one sender bot keeps delivery reliable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          See Channels for connection and management details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Why is my channel not posting?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Check the bot is still a channel admin with Post Messages, the timezone is correct, and the sender bot is connected.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Feedback Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Always include your user ID (from /premium) when contacting support.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Add screenshots or exact error text — they speed up fixes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Choose the right category (bug / feature / general) so reports route correctly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Check your feedback status — the bot keeps you updated via the Feedback menu.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            See Feedback for how to submit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What should I include in a bug report?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Your user ID, the exact error or screenshot, the channel involved, and what you expected to happen. This helps us fix it faster.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Language Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Change language with /language — it applies immediately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Set your timezone in the same settings area so schedule times align.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If your language is missing, use Feedback to request it — new languages are added over time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              See Language for the full list.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              How do I switch the bot language?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Send /language and pick your language. It applies immediately to all your channels.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Migration Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Pro Tips
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Moving to a new phone? Install the bot and connect the same channels as admin.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Use /import to restore settings and messages from a backup file.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Your Premium is tied to your Telegram account, so it follows you automatically.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Payment Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Telegram Stars monthly plans renew automatically; 3-month, 6-month, and yearly plans are one-time purchases.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep payment receipts — they help support verify issues quickly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Redeem promo codes before they expire.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Yearly plans are the best value per day.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  See Payments for how each method works.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Which payment method activates Premium fastest?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Telegram Stars activates instantly. See Payments for details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Premium Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Review Premium periodically to know your limits and usage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Recurring messages are unlimited on Premium — automate your digests.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • On expiry, use the Choose What to Keep menu to pick the channel you keep.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Renew before day 35+12h to restore everything instantly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    See Premium and Premium Expiry for details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What is the best Premium plan?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yearly plans give the best daily price. Compare plans in /premium to pick what fits your volume.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Preview Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Always preview before confirming a scheduled message.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The preview shows text, media, time, channel, and options.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • You can edit a preview — change time, channel, or content — before it's saved.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use Message List to re-open any message for preview later.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I edit a message after I preview it?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Yes — the preview lets you change time, channel, or content before confirming. After saving, edit it via Message List.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Queue Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Messages are processed in schedule order — earliest time first.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If many messages share the same time, they send in creation order.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Missed send windows are handled gracefully; check your sent reports.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Use reports for a send confirmation after each batch.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What order are queued messages sent?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Earliest scheduled time first; equal times are sent in creation order. Check sent reports for confirmations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Recurring Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Use recurring messages for daily digests, weekly roundups, or monthly posts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Premium unlocks unlimited recurring messages.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Recurring messages count separately from one-time scheduled messages.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • On Premium expiry you keep up to 1 recurring message — choose which.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          See Recurring for setup.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can recurring messages be paused?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Yes — open the recurring message in Message List to pause, edit, or delete it. Paused messages stop sending until resumed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Referral Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Share your invite link everywhere — groups, channels, your bio.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Friends must join and send enough messages for you to earn days.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Track your balance and referrals in /referral.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Watch for the minimum-message rule to avoid abuse.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            See Referral for rules and rewards.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            When do I get referral rewards?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            After invited friends join and send at least 1 messages. Track your balance in /referral.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Search Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Search matches keywords and partial words, case-insensitively.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • You can search by job ID (e.g. s_123).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Search covers all your channels at once.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Found messages can be previewed, edited, or deleted right from results.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              See Search for usage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Does search work across all channels?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Yes — search covers all your scheduled and recurring messages across every channel at once.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Security Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Pro Tips
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Enable Telegram two-step verification on your account.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Never share your bot token or payment details in chat.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Only grant channel admin (Post Messages) to the bot and your sender bots.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Revoke sender bot access from devices you no longer use.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Signature Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Signatures are appended after message content — great for branding.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • You can set a different signature per channel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep signatures short; they count toward the message length limit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Signatures are stripped when Premium expires (after day 3).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  See Signatures for setup.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Can I use one signature per channel?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Yes — each channel has its own signature setting. Signatures strip automatically when Premium expires after day 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Storage Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Pro Tips2 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Organize media into named boxes so messages are easy to reuse.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • On Premium expiry you can keep one storage box; keep the one you use most.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The kept box is trimmed to 100 items (videos first) on day 17.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Use storage to resend the same visuals repeatedly without re-uploading.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    See Media Storage for the full guide.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What happens to my storage on Premium expiry?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    On day 0 you pick one box to keep. Day 17: non-kept boxes are deleted and your kept box is trimmed to 100 items. Renew before then to keep everything.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I store videos in Media Storage?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes. Videos are kept within the per-item size limits (up to 25MB for free / up to 50MB for Premium) and stored separately from photos, without quality loss.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Time Zone Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Always set the time zone for each channel you use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Times in the calendar are shown in the channel's timezone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use /timezone to check or change it quickly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For audiences in a different region, schedule in their local time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      See Time Zone for details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Why do my posts send at the wrong time?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Your channel timezone is used for scheduling. Change it with /timezone to match your audience.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Troubleshoot Tips

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Pro Tips1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Messages not sending? Check the bot is still a channel admin.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Media failing? Check size limits and bot permissions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Late posts? Verify the channel's timezone and sender bot status.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • When stuck, check the Troubleshooting category first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For step-by-step fixes, open the Troubleshooting category.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Where do I start when something breaks?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Check the Troubleshooting category first. If it's still broken, use Feedback with your user ID, error text, and steps to reproduce.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The Best Times to Post in Telegram (and How to Test Them Properly)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Pro Tips2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          “Post at 9:00” advice is usually recycled guesswork. Here is what actually moves the needle on Telegram, plus a testing method you can run with a scheduler in one week.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Windows that generally work

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Morning commute — 8:00–10:00 local time. News, digests, “start of day” content.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Lunch dip — 12:30–14:00. Light, skimmable posts do well.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Evening prime time — 19:00–22:00. The strongest window for most channels; long-form and media belong here.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The key word is local. If your audience spans zones, anchor to your largest cluster's evening, and let the channel's time zone setting do the conversion for you.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Consistency beats cleverness

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Subscribers learn your rhythm. A channel that posts daily at 9:00 trains its audience to show up at 9:00 — measurable in view-rate stability. This is the strongest argument for scheduling (and recurring rules) over manual posting: the schedule becomes a product feature.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How to test slots properly

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 1. Pick two candidate slots (e.g. 9:00 vs 20:00) and alternate similar content between them for 7–10 days.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 2. Compare views in the first hour, not totals — that is when your regulars arrive. Fast Scheduler's statistics screen shows view dynamics per post.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 3. Keep the winner as a recurring rule, and re-test quarterly. Audiences drift with seasons and habits.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Small things that quietly help

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Don't stack posts 5 minutes apart — spacing beats bursts for notification fatigue.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Media posts slightly outperform text-only at equal times in most niches.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Skip the “dump 6 posts at midnight” pattern; Telegram's own limits and your subscribers' patience both prefer a steady drip.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Does Telegram show “time of post” that I can use for testing?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Views are timestamped; compare first-hour views across slots. The statistics screen gives you per-post numbers without extra tools.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Statistics Dashboard
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How many posts per day is healthy?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2–4 for most content channels. Beyond that, watch unsubscribes — the metric that punishes oversharing fastest.
