                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Feedback & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Feedback & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Every ticket goes to a human. Open Feedback in the bot (or /feedback), pick a category, and describe the issue — attach a file or screenshot if it helps.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What happens next
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • You get a ticket number immediately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Replies arrive in the bot chat; you can continue the conversation in the same thread.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • My requests shows the status of every ticket you filed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Bug reports with concrete details (job ID, time, what you expected vs. what happened) get fixed fastest.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Keep it clean
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Feedback must not contain offensive language. One mild expression triggers a warning (the message is still sent); heavily offensive messages are blocked, and 3 warnings temporarily block new feedback. Mistaken flags can be reported from the warning itself.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Send Feedback

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Feedback & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1. Open Feedback (or /feedback).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2. Choose a category: bug, feature request, payment, or other.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3. For payment issues, choose a subcategory such as refund, charged but Premium not activated, duplicate charge, cancellation or renewal, failed payment, plan/price/promo, or other payment issue.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            4. Describe the issue clearly and optionally attach a screenshot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            5. Submit - support reviews and replies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Premium users get priority response time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Feedback & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Report payment problems under Feedback → Payment, then choose a subcategory: refund, charged but Premium not activated, duplicate/incorrect charge, cancellation or renewal, failed payment, plan/price/promo, or other payment issue.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Status Meanings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Feedback & Support
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Open - received, not yet answered.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Replied - support answered; waiting on you or resolved.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Closed - the issue was resolved and closed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Spam - flagged as spam.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Premium reports are processed first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Scheduling FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Frequently Asked Questions15 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Questions people most often ask about scheduling: formats, editing, limits, multiple channels, media, recurring messages, and more. Tap a question below to see the answer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Do I need a sender bot to schedule messages?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. After connecting a channel, connect a sender bot for it from Bots - scheduling unlocks once every channel has its own bot. Posts then appear from your bot's name, and you also get lower delivery delays and per-channel statistics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I edit a message after I schedule it?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. Open Message List (or use /list), tap the message, then Edit — you can change the text, the date/time, the media, or even the target channel. Use /edit with the job ID for a direct shortcut.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                How many scheduled messages can I store?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Free plan: 100 pending messages stored at once. Premium: unlimited. If you go over the free limit you will receive a notice listing the excess; messages stay frozen but are not deleted.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                How many messages can I send per month?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Free plan: 100 sent messages per channel per calendar month. Premium: unlimited sends. There is no daily cap on either plan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I schedule the same message to multiple channels?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Each scheduled message targets one channel. Free plan: 1 channel. Premium: up to 3 channels, each with its own sender bot, time zone, and signature.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I schedule a poll or quiz?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. Create the poll/quiz in any chat and forward it to the bot during scheduling — or build it right in the scheduling flow, where supported. Note: Telegram only allows anonymous polls in channels.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What media can I attach to a scheduled message?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Photos, videos, GIFs, documents, and albums. Free plan videos: up to 25MB (no 4K). Premium: up to 50MB with 4K support. Use Normal, Random, or Sequential media modes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I schedule a recurring message (daily / weekly / monthly)?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. Free plan: 1 recurring message. Premium: unlimited. Set the interval and time, then manage it (edit, pause, delete) from Message List.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I use HH:MM to schedule for today?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. When entering the date, a time in HH:MM format schedules the message for today at that time. Full dates like 2026-08-20 14:30 also work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I upload a .txt file to schedule many messages at once?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. Send a .txt file and the bot parses it into multiple scheduled posts. This is the fastest way to build a month of content — combine it with the SetDate companion bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What time zone is used for my scheduled times?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Each channel has its own time zone (set in Channel Settings), which defaults to your account time zone. Verify the listed time zone before confirming a schedule.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What happens if my Premium expires during a schedule?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Nothing is deleted right away. Messages to non-kept channels stop sending after a grace period, and you get a prompt to download a full .fsback backup you can restore later with /import.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                How do I see everything I have scheduled?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Open Message List (or /list). You can preview, edit, pause, or delete any scheduled or recurring message there.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I schedule a forwarded message?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. During scheduling, forward a message from any chat — the bot copies its text and media into the scheduled post. You can edit the caption before confirming.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I schedule an album of photos?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. Send several photos together during the media step and choose Normal mode — they post as a single grouped album.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Sender Bot FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Frequently Asked Questions3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A sender bot is required for every channel: posts appear from your bot's name, with lower delay, better security, and per-channel stats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  One bot per channel. Free: 1 bot; Premium: up to 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why should I add a sender bot?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A sender bot is required for every channel - posts are sent through it, so they appear from your own bot's name with lower delivery delay and per-channel statistics. Connect one from Bots before scheduling.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  How do I create and connect a sender bot?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Create the bot with @BotFather (/newbot), add it as an admin in your channel, then enter its token in Sender Bots Management. One bot per channel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Why is my bot not posting?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Make sure the bot is an admin in the channel, the token is correct, the channel is connected, and you have not hit the Free plan monthly send cap (100 per channel).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Payment FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Frequently Asked Questions5 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Everything about paying for Premium: methods, auto-renewal, cancellation, and refunds.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Tap a question below for the answer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How do I pay for Premium?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Choose a plan in the Premium menu and pay with Telegram Stars. Premium activates immediately after payment is confirmed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Is the payment auto-renewing?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The monthly Stars plan auto-renews until cancelled. Prepaid 3-month, 6-month, and yearly plans are one-time — you buy a fixed period with no automatic charge.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When does my Premium expire?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Your expiration date is shown in the Premium menu and in the status line under /premium. You will get reminders before it ends.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I cancel Premium?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes, for the auto-renewing monthly plan: open the Premium menu and tap Cancel Premium. It stops future auto-renewal — you keep Premium until the end of the current paid period, then the standard expiry process begins. Prepaid 3/6-month and yearly plans never auto-renew, so there is nothing to cancel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I get a refund?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Refunds are handled case by case. Contact @MaximalXP with the payment details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Billing FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Frequently Asked Questions4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Billing details: methods, auto-renewal, renewed payments, and plan changes. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What payment methods are supported?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Telegram Stars. The monthly Stars plan auto-renews; 3-month and 6-month prepaid plans come with a 10% / 14% discount vs paying monthly and are one-time purchases; yearly Stars plans are also one-time purchases.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I combine a promo code with a referral?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Promo codes and referral bonuses can both grant Premium time. For the exact stacking behavior and your current status check the Referral help section.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What happens if my auto-renewal payment fails?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      You get a bounded grace period with 'Automatic renewal failed' notices. If the charge never succeeds, the standard Premium expiry process begins.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I switch plans later?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      While Premium is active you can choose another plan when renewing. After expiry you re-subscribe from the Premium menu.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Account FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Frequently Asked Questions4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Your account, user ID, language, and data. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How is my account created?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Your account is created automatically the first time you use the bot — there is no sign-up form. Your Telegram identity is your account.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Where do I find my user ID?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Open /premium — your user ID is shown in the status section.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Can I change my account language or time zone?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Yes. Use the language menu to switch languages, and the time zone settings to choose how your scheduled times are interpreted.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How do I delete my account and data?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Contact @MaximalXP to request deletion. If you want a copy first, download a full backup via /backup.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Security FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Frequently Asked Questions4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How your tokens and data are protected. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Where are my bot tokens stored?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Bot tokens are stored encrypted and used only to post on your behalf. Never paste a token into chats or send it to anyone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Is my data shared or sold?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No. Your data is not sold or shared with third parties except what is needed to process payments.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can someone log into my account?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No password-based login exists. Access is tied to your Telegram account — only you can control your channels and bots.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How do I delete my data?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Contact @MaximalXP and request account deletion. You can also /export or download a full .fsback backup first if you want to keep a copy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Storage FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Frequently Asked Questions4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Media Storage saves photos, videos, GIFs, and documents for reuse. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What is Media Storage?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Media Storage saves photos, videos, GIFs, and documents so you can reuse them in scheduled posts via the From Storage mode — no need to re-upload every time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            How much can I store?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Free plan: 1 box with 100 items. Premium: 20 boxes with 500 items total plus up to 50MB videos per item max.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Are stored items ever deleted automatically?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            No. Items stay in storage while you use the bot. On Premium expiry the non-kept storage boxes are cleaned up after the grace period — you choose which one (if any) to keep.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            How do I use a stored file in a scheduled message?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            At the media step choose From Storage and pick the file you want, or use Random / Sequential to rotate through your saved media.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Migration FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Frequently Asked Questions4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Moving your publishing setup between accounts, bots, or servers. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              How do I move my messages to a new account?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Use /export from the old account to create a file, then /import in the new account. Either option. For everything at once use a full backup.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What is the full backup format?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A .fsback file, created with /backup (Premium) or offered during Premium expiry. It contains your scheduled, recurring, channels, bots, media, and settings — restore with /import.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Can I import data while keeping my new setup?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Yes. The import merges into your current account rather than replacing it wholesale.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              I got a .fsback file from the expiry download — how do I use it?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Send the file to the bot and use /import. It restores your data, so you can continue where you left off. No password is needed for the expiry backup.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tips FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Frequently Asked Questions5 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Practical tricks to get more from the scheduler. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What's the fastest way to schedule for today?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type a time like 14:30 when the bot asks for the date — it schedules for today at that time. No need to type a full date.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                How do I schedule a whole month quickly?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Upload a .txt file with one post per block; the bot parses them into scheduled messages. Or use the SetDate companion bot to generate a full month fast.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Should I set a per-channel time zone?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes if your audience is global. Each channel can have its own time zone, so posts go out at the right local time per channel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                How do I avoid gaps in my schedule?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Use the Calendar View to see which days are empty, and set recurring messages for the regular posts you never want to forget.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What's the best way to run a big campaign?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Space it over several days instead of one burst to maximize reach, reuse on-brand media from storage, and take a backup before large changes.
