                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Frequently Asked Questions5 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Most common problems and their quick fixes. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My scheduled message did not send. Why?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Check, in order: the channel is connected, the sender bot (if used) is an admin with the token correct, the Free plan monthly send cap (100 per channel) is not reached, and the message is not paused or past its time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The message went out at the wrong time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The channel's time zone (or your account time zone) decides local send time. Verify it in Channel Settings, then reschedule.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  I accidentally started a flow / nothing responds.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Type /cancel to abort the current flow and return to the menu.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  I paid for Premium but it is not active.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Payment confirmation can take a moment. Wait a few minutes and open /premium. If it still shows Free, contact @MaximalXP with the payment receipt.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My media did not attach to the scheduled post.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Make sure you chose a media mode (Normal / Random / Sequential) during scheduling and that the file is within the size limit for your plan (10 MB free / 100 MB premium).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Telegram FAQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Frequently Asked Questions4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How Telegram platform rules interact with scheduled posts and payments. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Why can't I schedule a regular (named) poll?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Telegram only allows anonymous polls in channels. Create the poll as anonymous, or forward a poll you created in another chat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Are link previews shown in scheduled posts?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Link previews follow Telegram behavior per message — the bot preserves the settings you used when composing the post.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does content protection affect scheduled posts?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If your channel has content protection enabled, it applies to all posts, including scheduled ones. Media sent by the bot will respect that setting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What are Telegram Stars?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Stars are Telegram's in-app currency for digital purchases. You can use them to buy Premium from within the bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The SetDate companion bot and automation questions. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What is the SetDate companion bot?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      It is a companion that helps you build a full month of posts quickly; your schedules are then managed here, in Fast Scheduler.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Do I need a separate API token for it?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      No. The companion reuses your connected channel setup — no separate token is required.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Where do I find my tokens?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Bot tokens are used internally to post on your behalf and are stored encrypted. Keep them secret and never paste them into chats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I automate beyond the companion?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      See the Sender Bots category and the inline-scheduling options for the supported automation surface.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Best Practices

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Frequently Asked Questions5 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Tips on when and how to post for the best results. Tap a question below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        When is the best time to post?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Schedule at times your audience is active. Use your per-channel statistics to see which hours and days perform best.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How should I structure a big campaign?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Space it over several days instead of one burst. Steady, consistent posting outperforms a random flood.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I reuse media?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Yes — keep on-brand media in Media Storage and reuse it with Random or Sequential modes rather than re-uploading.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Why back up before big changes?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A full .fsback backup lets you restore everything if something goes wrong during a rework, reconnection, or migration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What should I run as recurring?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Anything regular — daily quotes, weekly digests, monthly announcements. Recurring messages handle the rhythm so you only schedule the one-offs manually.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How to Move Fast Scheduler to a New Phone or Another Telegram Account

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Frequently Asked Questions2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fast Scheduler stores your schedules in the cloud (on the bot's server), not on your phone. That makes moving house surprisingly painless — the only thing that really matters is which Telegram account owns the schedules.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Same account, new phone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Do nothing. Open Telegram on the new phone, log in, and chat with @FastSchedulerBot — your channels, bots, schedules and settings are exactly where you left them. There is no local app and nothing to sync.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Different account (new number, team handover, second project)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Schedules belong to the Telegram account that created them, so a new account starts empty. The clean path:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 1. On the old account: /backup → include everything → save the .fsback/.fspback file.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 2. On the new account: /start the bot, connect the channel, then pair its sender bot (this is mandatory — the sender bot is what actually posts).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 3. Send /import with the backup file, choose Add or Overwrite.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 4. Check the Message List and Calendar; confirm the time zone matches, then skim the first few upcoming posts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If you are on Free and your setup has more than one channel, temporarily move the extra channels out or upgrade — the restore brings everything over, but Free limits apply on the new account.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Handing a channel to someone else permanently

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The same flow works for handovers: the new owner connects their own account to the same channel (they need admin rights in it), pairs a sender bot, and imports the backup you send them. After they confirm the Message List looks right, you can delete your own schedules to avoid double-posting — two accounts scheduling the same channel will post twice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Will my schedules keep firing while I migrate?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Yes — the old account keeps posting until you delete its schedules or the channel/bot setup changes. Pause or delete there before going live on the new account to avoid duplicates.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Why Is My Telegram Channel Posting Twice? (Duplicate Posts, Explained)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Do I need Premium on the new account to restore?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No. Importing a backup is free. Premium is only needed for creating backups and for the extra channels/bots the backup may contain.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Ask in Telegram
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Help CenterFrequently Asked QuestionsWhy Is My Telegram Channel Posting Twice? (Duplicate Posts, Explained)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Why Is My Telegram Channel Posting Twice? (Duplicate Posts, Explained)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Frequently Asked Questions2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Double posts are annoying for subscribers and make a channel look automated in the worst way. The good news: the cause is nearly always one of four things.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1. Another account still schedules the channel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The most common cause after a migration or team handover: the old account's schedules were never removed. Both accounts happily queue posts for the same time. Fix: in the other account, open Message List and delete its schedules (or disconnect the channel). If you cannot access the old account, remove the bot from the channel's admin list — that stops the posting immediately.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2. Two sender bots are admin in the channel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Every channel must pair with exactly one sender bot, and that bot should be the only bot with posting rights. If you created a second bot and added it as admin, posts may arrive from both. Keep one sender bot per channel as admin; remove extra bots from the channel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3. The message got scheduled twice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Easy to do when re-sending the same text after an edit, or when importing while old schedules exist. Open the Message List for the day and scan for same-time twins before the posting window. The Calendar view makes clusters obvious.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          4. The recurrence rule was duplicated, not edited

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Creating a new daily rule instead of editing the existing one produces two identical posts every day. Check the recurring list — if two rules share the same text and time, delete one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Still posting twice?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Send /stats to see what is queued, then use /feedback with the channel name and two timestamps of a duplicate pair. Support can trace which connection produced each post.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Does Fast Scheduler retry a post that failed, causing doubles?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A retry only happens when the send did not confirm. If Telegram accepted the post but the confirmation was lost (rare network hiccup), you can get one duplicate. It does not re-send confirmed posts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can I merge two accounts scheduling the same channel?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Yes — export from the old account, import with Add on the new one, then clear the old account. Never leave both active.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Telegram Channels vs Groups vs Bots: The Difference That Actually Matters

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Frequently Asked Questions2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Telegram has three kinds of “places”, and content creators mix them up constantly. Here is the mental model that sticks.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A channel is a megaphone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          One-way broadcasting: admins post, subscribers read. No reply threads by default (though a discussion group can be attached), unlimited subscribers, and posts carry the channel's name — or the name of the posting bot if “Sign messages with a bot” is on. Channels are where scheduled content lives.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A group is a campfire

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Everyone talks. Groups are for community; up to 200k members in supergroups, full message history, topics if enabled. You do not “schedule to a group” the way you do to a channel — that is what channels are for.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A bot is a worker

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Bots are accounts run by software. In your channel's context, a bot is the hands that type the message: a bot must be an admin with Post Messages for anything to be published. That is exactly why Fast Scheduler pairs a sender bot with your channel — your bot posts, under your brand.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Why this matters for scheduling

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Want posts to appear at fixed times? Channel + scheduler + sender bot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Want subscribers to discuss the posts? Attach a linked discussion group to the channel — comments live there automatically.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Want automation, menus, and commands? That is the bot layer — the part Fast Scheduler turns into a full publishing workflow.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          One nuance worth knowing: Telegram shows signed posts as “via bot” only when the admin chooses to sign with the bot; otherwise the post simply appears under the channel name. Either way, the sender bot did the typing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can a scheduled post go to a group?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fast Scheduler targets channels (including chat-announcement channels). Groups are conversational — schedule announcements to a channel instead.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Channels
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Do subscribers see which bot posted?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          By default a channel post shows just the channel name. If the channel enables signing posts with the admin bot, the sender bot is credited.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Do You Need a Sender Bot to Schedule Posts? (Yes — Here Is Why)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How Do I Schedule Many Telegram Posts at Once? (Bulk Scheduling with SetDate)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Frequently Asked Questions3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Scheduling one post is quick. Scheduling thirty — a week of content for a news channel, a course drip, a product launch sequence — needs a different tool: SetDate, the companion bot built for exactly this.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The five-minute bulk workflow

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 1. Open SetDate. Open @SetDate_bot directly — or tap 📅 Use SetDate Bot whenever Fast Scheduler suggests it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 2. Feed it content. Send your text messages one after another — typed, pasted, or uploaded as a .txt file. Photos and videos are attached later, when you pick media options during import.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 3. Choose a start date and how many posts should go out per day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 4. Define posting times — for example 09:00, 14:00 and 18:00 — and SetDate distributes your messages across that grid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 5. Send the batch back. One tap and every message appears in Fast Scheduler as a normal scheduled post, fully editable afterwards.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Why this beats scheduling by hand

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • One sitting instead of thirty. You write all content while you are in the writing mood, then let the grid place it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Perfect for recurring formats. A daily tip at 10:00 for the next two weeks is two fields in SetDate, not fourteen conversations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Everything stays editable. After import, each post is a regular scheduled message — search it, edit it, delete it, or move it in the calendar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Bulk for repeated content: recurring messages

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If the same message should repeat — a weekly digest, a daily reminder — you do not need bulk import at all: create a recurring message once and it reschedules itself. Free plans run 1 recurring message; Premium removes the cap (Unlimited) and its rules never expire.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Tip: before importing a large batch, glance at your channel’s time zone (see the time-zone guide) so the grid lands on the hours you actually meant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What is the SetDate bot?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SetDate is Fast Scheduler’s companion bot for bulk scheduling: you prepare many messages there, choose a start date and daily posting times, and import them all into Fast Scheduler in one click.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SetDate Integration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can I edit posts after bulk import?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Yes. Imported messages become ordinary scheduled messages — open the Message List or calendar and edit, move or delete any of them individually.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can I Edit a Scheduled Post After Scheduling It?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How many posts can I import at once?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          SetDate handles up to 500 posts (200,000 characters, 20 MB .txt) per batch. Imported messages also count against your scheduled-message limit (100 pending on Free, unlimited on Premium), so a batch that fits both caps can be imported in one go.
