                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Telegram Channel vs Group: What Is the Difference and Which One Do You Need?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Frequently Asked Questions2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          New Telegram creators constantly mix these up, and picking wrong shapes everything after it — including how you schedule. Here is the short, practical version.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The one-line difference

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A channel is a megaphone: only admins publish, everyone else reads. A group is a round table: every member can post and reply. A channel can have a linked discussion group, which adds a comment thread under every channel post — the best of both worlds.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Choose a channel when…

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • You publish content to an audience: news, deals, tutorials, drops.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • You want a clean feed readers can scroll without chatter.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • You care about per-post view counts — channels show them, groups do not.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Choose a group when…

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Conversation is the product: support, community, coordination.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • You want members to see each other and reply freely.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The classic combo

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Most serious projects end up with both: a channel for polished posts, plus a linked discussion group for the conversation under them. Telegram links them in the channel settings; from then on every channel post automatically gets a comment thread.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Where Fast Scheduler fits

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fast Scheduler publishes to channels — that is where scheduled broadcast content belongs. Because it also tracks the discussion-group comments under the posts it publishes, your statistics cover the conversational side too: average comments per post and Top Commenters leaderboards work with the combo setup out of the box. The practical recipe: plan and queue polished posts in the channel, and let the linked group absorb the discussion they spark.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can Fast Scheduler post to groups?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fast Scheduler schedules to channels, which is the broadcast use case it is built for. For community discussion, create a channel with a linked discussion group — comments there are tracked in your statistics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ChannelsStatistics Dashboard
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What is a discussion group in Telegram?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A group linked to your channel in channel settings. Every channel post gets a comment thread in that group, giving readers a place to reply without polluting the channel feed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What Is Fast Scheduler? The Telegram Post Scheduling Bot Explained

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Frequently Asked Questions3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fast Scheduler (@FastSchedulerBot) is a Telegram bot that plans and publishes posts to your channels on a schedule — the missing native feature Telegram never shipped properly. You write content when inspiration strikes; the bot delivers it at the hour your audience actually reads.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How it works in three roles

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The main bot (@FastSchedulerBot) is your control room: every conversation, every schedule, every statistic happens here.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Your channel — connect it once by making the bots admins; the bot verifies rights and tracks it from then on.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A sender bot — a small bot of your own (created in @BotFather in two minutes) that actually publishes the posts, so your channel’s byline is your brand, not ours. Connecting one is required: scheduling unlocks only after each channel has a sender bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What you can do with it

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Schedule anything — text, photos, videos, GIFs, voice, stickers, documents, polls, albums, with full formatting, spoilers and URL buttons.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Recurring messages — a post that repeats daily, weekly or on custom patterns without re-scheduling.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Bulk import — prepare a week of content in the SetDate companion bot and import it in one click.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Statistics — views, comments and reactions per channel, with leaderboards of your top posts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Team features — admin permissions, shared channel limits, ownership transfer with confirmation phrases.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Backups & export — encrypted .fspback backups, JSON/CSV exports, migration between accounts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Free vs Premium, honestly

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Free: 1 channel and sender bot, 100 pending scheduled messages, 100 sends per channel per month, 1 recurring message — enough to run one channel seriously.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Premium ($6.83/mo or $68.03/yr): 3 channels and sender bots, unlimited scheduled queue, unlimited sends, unlimited recurring messages, bigger uploads (100 MB), leaderboards, backups, inline buttons and more.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Who it is for

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          News channels that publish on rhythm, creators who batch their week in one sitting, shops running drops at precise hours, and community managers who share channels with a team. If you have ever set a 3 a.m. alarm to post manually — this bot is the cure.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Start here: open @FastSchedulerBot, press Start, connect your channel, pair a sender bot, and schedule your first post before your coffee cools.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Is Fast Scheduler free?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Yes — the Free plan runs one channel with 100 pending scheduled messages and 100 sends per channel per month, forever. Premium at $6.83/mo lifts every cap and adds statistics leaderboards, backups and bigger uploads.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Free Plan LimitsPremium
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Why does Fast Scheduler need a sender bot?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Your sender bot publishes the posts, so your channel’s byline is your own brand instead of a third-party bot. It is created by you in @BotFather and connected in two minutes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Posting as Your Bot
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can Fast Scheduler send messages to a Telegram channel automatically?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Yes. That is its core purpose: scheduled messages publish automatically at their set time through your sender bot, including media, formatting and buttons.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Text Commands4 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fast Scheduler Bot can be controlled with text commands — handy on desktop or when you open the bot from a search.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Pick a command below for details, or use the main-menu buttons for the same features. Commands work with both the main bot and the @setdate companion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What other features are available?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Search finds messages by keyword. Statistics shows your usage. Calendar gives a monthly overview.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Searching MessagesStatistics DashboardCalendar View
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How do I find my messages?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Use Search (/search) to find by keyword, or Message List (/list) to browse all.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Searching MessagesMessage List
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What is /cancel used for?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          /cancel stops any active operation and returns you to the main menu. Useful if the bot is waiting for input and you want to start over.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How do I use a promo code?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Go to Premium → Redeem Promo Code, or use /promocode. Enter the code exactly as provided.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Text Commands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Here is the full command list:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /start — open the main menu
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /help — help center
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /channel — connect or manage a channel
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /schedule — schedule a message
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /recurring — create a recurring message
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /list — see all scheduled messages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /search — search your messages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /calendar — monthly calendar view
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /delete — delete messages or media
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /bots — manage sender bots
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /storage — manage media storage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /premium — view or buy Premium
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /referral — invite friends and earn days
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /language — change language
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /timezone — manage timezones
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /stats — usage statistics
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /data — import/export hub
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /export — export messages as a file
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /import — import messages from a file
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /backup — create/restore a backup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /feedback — feedback & support
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /paysupport — payments support
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /cancel — cancel any active operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /dub — duplicate a scheduled message
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /edit — edit a scheduled message
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /signature — signature menu
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /promocode — apply a promo code
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /addbot — connect a sender bot
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /listbots — list your sender bots
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /removebot — remove a sender bot
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /skip — skip the current step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • /newchannel — connect a new channel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Most features are also reachable from the main menu buttons.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              /schedule

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Text Commands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Starts the message scheduling flow.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. Send /schedule (or press Schedule)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. Choose a channel
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3. Enter the date/time (e.g. 25.12.2024 10:00)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4. Send the message text and/or media
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              5. Preview and confirm

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              You can also schedule many messages at once by sending a .txt file — see Batch Scheduling in the Scheduling category.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Text Commands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Searches all your scheduled and recurring messages by keyword or job ID.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. Send /search
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. Type a keyword or part of the text
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3. The bot lists matching messages across all channels
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                4. Tap a result to preview, edit, or delete it

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Search is case-insensitive and matches partial words. For browsing by channel use Message List (/list).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  From here you can:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • See your current plan and usage vs limits
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Buy or upgrade to Premium (monthly, 3-month, 6-month, or yearly)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Cancel or re-enable auto-renewal
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check the expiry timeline if Premium ended

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  See the Premium category for a full feature list and FAQ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    /referral

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Text Commands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Opens the referral program: invite friends and earn free Premium days.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How it works:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • You get a unique invite link
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Friends who join and send enough messages earn you reward days
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Your balance and history are shown here

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    See the Referral category for rules and reward details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Settings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Text Commands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      There is no single Settings screen. Each setting lives in its own menu or command:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /language — interface language
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /timezone — timezones
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /signature — default signature for new messages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /channel — connected channels

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Settings are stored per-user and apply across all your channels.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        /language

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Text Commands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Changes the bot's interface language.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Send /language
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2. Pick your language from the list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3. The bot language switches immediately

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Your choice is saved per-user, not per-channel, and applies to all your channels in this bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        See also: Language category for FAQ about adding new languages.
