                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Troubleshooting

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Troubleshooting8 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Something went wrong? Every error has a cause and a fix. Tap a question below — the most common cases (messages not posting, late posts, media failures, permission problems) each have a dedicated answer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How do I exit a stuck flow?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Use the /cancel command at any time to exit the current operation and return to the main menu.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Payment went through but Premium didn't activate

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Wait 2-3 minutes — there can be a small delay with some payment providers. If still not active after 5 minutes, check with /premium. If Premium still shows as inactive, contact @MaximalXP with your user ID, payment method, and transaction details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          I used a referral link but didn't get Premium days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Referral Premium days are only credited when the referred person 1) is a NEW user (never used the bot before), and 2) connects a channel. Just starting the bot with the link is not enough. Check /referral to see your status. Contact @MaximalXP if requirements were met.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My scheduled messages stopped sending

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Check: 1) Your sender bot is still connected and is admin in the channel. 2) You haven't hit the Free plan monthly send cap (100 per channel). 3) The channel hasn't been removed. 4) Your Premium hasn't expired (if you had channels above the free limit). Use /stats to check your status.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Premium ExpiryFrozen Assets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          I accidentally deleted something — can I recover it?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If you have a backup (.fsback or .fspback file), you can restore it with /import. Without a backup, deleted data cannot be recovered. We recommend regular exports to avoid data loss.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How do I delete my account or all my data?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Contact @MaximalXP directly to request account deletion. You can also manually delete your data using the export/backup feature first to keep a copy. Your scheduled messages, media, and settings will be permanently removed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can I get a refund for Premium?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. Contact @MaximalXP directly with your payment details and reason for the refund request. Refunds are not guaranteed but are reviewed individually.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My bot token was revoked by @BotFather

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If you reset your bot token in @BotFather, the old token stops working immediately. Go to Bots → 🔁 Replace Token under the bot and enter the new token from @BotFather. Your scheduled messages will resume once the new token is saved.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Common Errors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "Bot is not an admin" - add the bot as an administrator in the channel with Post Messages permission.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "Invalid token" - copy the FULL token from @BotFather, no extra spaces.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "Channel not found" - check the username/link; use @username or an invite link.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "Limit reached" - check /stats; delete old messages or upgrade.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Most errors are fixed by one of these. See Troubleshooting for the full guide.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Network Errors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Messages queue while the bot or Telegram is offline and send when it's back - nothing is lost.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If a sender bot shows disconnected, verify its token and admin status.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Long downtimes are rare; check Bots status to confirm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If the problem persists, contact support via Feedback.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Timeouts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Slow internet or large media can cause timeouts - retry the action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Large imports run in the background; check progress.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • If timeouts repeat, reduce file sizes or split the operation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Queued work continues once the connection is stable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Rate Limited

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Telegram and the bot throttle very fast bursts of actions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If you hit a rate limit, wait a few seconds and retry.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Free plan has a monthly send cap (100 per channel) - check /stats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Premium removes the send caps entirely.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Media Errors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • "File too large" - videos over up to 25MB on Free / up to 50MB on Premium. Compress or upgrade.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • "Unsupported format" - use common formats (MP4, JPG, PNG, GIF, PDF).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • "Media not found" - the file was removed from storage; the message becomes text-only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Re-upload the media to fix.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Help CenterTroubleshootingChannel Errors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Channel Errors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Bot is not an admin - add the bot as admin (Post Messages permission).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Channel not found - wrong username or link; verify @yourchannel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Invalid format - use @username, a full invite link, or the numeric ID.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Can't connect - make sure you're the owner or an admin.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Fix the cause and try connecting again.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Forbidden

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • "Bot was kicked from the chat" - re-add the bot as admin.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • "Bot can't post" - grant Post Messages permission.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • "Blocked by user" - the channel owner removed the bot; re-invite it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        These are Telegram permission errors - fix them in your channel settings, not in the bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Payment Errors

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Payment failed / declined" - Telegram declined the Stars charge; check your Stars balance and try again.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Not activated yet" - wait 2-3 min, then reopen /premium.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If Stars were taken but nothing activated, contact @MaximalXP with your user ID and transaction details.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Include the transaction ID when contacting support.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            No Post Sent

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Troubleshooting

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            If nothing was posted:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Confirm the bot is a channel admin with Post Messages.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Check the schedule time and timezone are correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Verify the sender bot is connected and online.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Look at Message List to confirm the message still exists (not deleted/expired).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Use the Troubleshooting topics for permission and rate-limit fixes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Late Post

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Troubleshooting

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If a message posts later than scheduled:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Check the channel timezone — schedule times use it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Verify the sender bot is online and an admin.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Telegram can delay delivery under load — the bot retries.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Check the sent report for the actual posting time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Set the correct timezone to fix the issue.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Media Fails

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Troubleshooting

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                If media doesn't post:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Check file size against limits (10 MB free / 100 MB Premium per item; videos up to 25MB / up to 50MB).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Make sure the file format is supported by Telegram.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Confirm the bot has permission to post media.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Corrupted uploads fail — re-upload the file.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Re-schedule the message after fixing the file.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Permission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Troubleshooting

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Missing permissions cause most posting failures:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Make the bot an admin of the channel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Grant Post Messages (and Delete Messages for media cleanup).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For sender bots, ensure they also have the needed rights.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If you use a private link, ensure you're the owner/admin.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The bot verifies permissions automatically after you update them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Bot Down

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Troubleshooting1 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If a sender bot stops responding:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Check that the bot is still an admin in the channel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Reconnect the sender bot from Sender Bots.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Telegram restarts bots from time to time — wait a couple of minutes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • If messages queue up, they resume once the bot is back.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If problems continue, contact support with the affected channel and bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What do I do when a bot seems offline?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Reconnect the sender bot from Sender Bots and confirm it's a channel admin. Telegram restarts bots periodically — wait a few minutes before retrying.

The 6 Real Causes, In Order of Likelihood

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Scheduled Message Didn’t Post? The 6 Real Causes, In Order of Likelihood

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Troubleshooting2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When a post misses its slot, the cause is almost always in the delivery chain — the schedule itself is the least likely suspect. Work this list top to bottom; each item fixes the majority of cases.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. The sender bot lost its admin seat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Someone cleaned up admins and removed your sender bot. Check Manage Channel → Administrators: your sender bot must be there with Post Messages. Re-add it, and the queue resumes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. The token was revoked or replaced

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A /revoke in @BotFather kills the old token everywhere instantly. If the bot shows the sender as disconnected, open Bots → 🔁 Replace Token under the bot and paste the fresh token.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3. Permissions were narrowed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Admin exists but without Post Messages — a silent killer after permission tightening. Open the admin entry and re-enable posting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. The channel changed identity

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Username changed or the channel was converted — the old link no longer resolves. Reconnect the channel; schedules are kept.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      5. Telegram rate limits on bursts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Telegram throttles aggressive posting bursts channel-wide. If several posts fire close together and one fails, it is usually this. Space posts by minutes, not seconds — the scheduler already does, but third-party bots added to the channel can collide with it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      6. The monthly send cap (Free)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      On Free, sends pause at 100 per channel per month until the 1st. The bot warns you before the cap; /stats shows the counter. Premium lifts the cap entirely.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Fastest diagnosis

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Send /stats (status of everything) and check the sender-bot status screen. Still mysterious? /feedback with the channel and the missed time — support can see delivery attempts and will tell you exactly which step failed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Will missed posts send later automatically?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A post that failed delivery is marked failed, not silently retried forever. Fix the underlying cause, then delete it and schedule it again.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Troubleshooting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      How do I know if it was the monthly cap?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The bot notifies you at the cap, and /stats shows monthly usage per channel. If neither shows the cap, it was delivery-side — start the checklist from the top.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Privacy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Privacy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What the bot stores and why:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Telegram identifiers — your user ID and channel IDs, so the bot knows what it manages and for whom.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Content you schedule — message texts and media references, kept only to deliver your posts on time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Settings — language, time zone, signatures, bot tokens you connect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Operational logs — delivery results, used to fix failures and show you statistics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The bot never reads channels it is not connected to, never posts anything you did not schedule, and never shares your data with third parties. Deleting a message in the bot deletes it from storage; deleting your account deletes everything. Full details are in the website Privacy Policy.
