                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Privacy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The bot stores what's needed to run: your channels, scheduled/recurring messages, settings, and referral info.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        It doesn't read your other chats or messages. Media uploads are compressed and stored only for your schedules.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Export or delete your data anytime - see Privacy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Third Parties

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Privacy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            We share data only where required to deliver the service:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Payment provider (Telegram Stars) for processing payments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Telegram itself for sending your messages.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            No data is sold, rented, or used for advertising.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Token Safety

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Privacy1 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Your bot token is like a password for your sender bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Never share it publicly (screenshots, support chats).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If leaked, reset it in @BotFather and Replace Token in the bot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Tokens are stored encrypted.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A leaked token lets anyone post as your bot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Should I keep my bot token secret?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Absolutely. Never share your sender bot token or payment details in chat. Anyone with a token could post to your channels.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Account Safety

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Privacy1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Access to the bot is tied to your Telegram account (no extra passwords).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Enable Telegram's two-step verification for extra security on your account.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Never send your bot token or payment details in plain chat to strangers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Telegram's own security settings protect your login.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Do I need Telegram two-step verification?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Recommended. Two-step verification protects your Telegram login — and therefore your bot access and connected channels — from unauthorized use.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Data Safety

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Privacy1 Q&A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Your data is stored securely and used only for the service.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It's not sold or shared beyond payment processing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Export a backup regularly (/backup) to keep a copy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Request deletion anytime via @MaximalXP.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      See Privacy for the full policy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Where is my data stored?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Your data is stored by the bot and used only to run schedules. Export or backup your data anytime, and contact support for data-related requests.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How Do I Delete My Fast Scheduler Account and All My Data?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Privacy3 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        You can leave Fast Scheduler completely — no subscriptions to cancel by email, no dark patterns, no “are you sure” maze. One message, and everything tied to your Telegram account is erased.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How to request deletion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Contact @MaximalXP in Telegram and ask to delete your account. Deletion is permanent and covers all data associated with your user ID: scheduled and recurring messages, media storage, sender-bot tokens, channel connections, settings, statistics and referral records.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Export first — deletion has no undo

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Before deleting, create a backup with /backup (a Premium toolkit) or export individual lists, so your content plan survives the account. Once deletion runs, there is no recovery path — the data no longer exists to restore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What happens on Telegram’s side

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Your sender bots keep existing in @BotFather — they are your bots, created with your account. If you want them gone too, revoke or delete them there after deletion. Revoke first if you plan to keep using them elsewhere.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The bot loses admin rights relevance immediately, but you can also remove @FastSchedulerBot and your sender bot from your channels’ admin lists yourself — a good hygiene step that takes ten seconds per channel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Already-published posts stay in your channel, of course — deletion cannot rewrite history.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How long data is kept normally

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        While you are an active user, every category of data is kept only while it is useful: schedules until they are deleted or sent, bot tokens until you disconnect the bot, and account records until you delete the account. The Privacy Policy’s retention table lists each category with its exact lifetime.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Who do I contact to delete my Fast Scheduler account?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Message @MaximalXP on Telegram and request account deletion. The deletion is permanent and removes all data linked to your Telegram ID.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Delete AccountYour Data
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Can I delete everything but keep the bot?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Yes — you can delete individual schedules, media and sender bots from inside the bot without deleting your account. Full deletion is only for leaving the service entirely.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Your Data
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I export a backup before deleting?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Definitely. After deletion there is no way to restore anything, so create a backup with /backup first if there is any chance you will return.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Contact & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The fastest way to get help is Telegram support (@MaximalXP).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            To help us answer quickly, send:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Your user ID (shown in /premium)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A short description of the problem
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A screenshot, if it's a visual issue
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The channel name involved, when relevant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Telegram messages are usually answered within a few hours.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Email

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Contact & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              For formal requests, contracts, or bulk deals you can write an email.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Include in the email:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Your user ID (from /premium)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A clear subject (support, partnership, etc.)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Screenshots or links when relevant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Email is checked less often than Telegram support, so expect a slower reply.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Report a Bug

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Contact & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Found something broken? Two easy ways to report it:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In the bot: use /feedback and choose Report a Bug
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Telegram: write to @MaximalXP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Please include:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Your user ID (from /premium)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What you did right before the issue
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The exact error text or screenshot
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The affected channel, if any

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                When you report a bug, we collect:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Your user ID (not your phone number)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The bot version and error logs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The channel/bot involved (only if you mention it)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What happens next:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. Your report gets a status in /feedback
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. We reproduce and fix the issue
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3. You're notified once it's resolved

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Adding a precise description and screenshot cuts the fix time dramatically.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Request a Feature

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Contact & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Want something new in Fast Scheduler? Suggest it!

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use /feedback and choose Request a Feature
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Or write to @MaximalXP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A good feature request includes:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • What you want to achieve
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • How you imagine using it (a short example)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Why it would help you

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Popular requests are tracked and prioritized. Once released, you'll see the update in the Feedback menu and the change log.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Response Time

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Contact & Support

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How fast you'll get an answer depends on the channel:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Telegram support — usually within a few hours (weekdays)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Email — 1-3 business days
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Bug reports — fixed and confirmed via feedback status

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Include your user ID and details to get the fastest reply.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How fast do you answer?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Most reports get a reply within a day or two. Premium reports are answered first — when you submit, add as much detail as you can (screenshots, steps, transaction IDs) so the issue can be fixed without extra back-and-forth.
