                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Settings & Configuration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Settings & Configuration2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Configure Fast Scheduler to work exactly how you want.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Language
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use /language or tap Language on the main menu
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose from available languages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Changes sync with @SetDate_bot (you'll be asked to confirm)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • See Language help topic for details about sync, disabling, and hiding notifications

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Timezone
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use /timezone to set your timezone
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Set per-channel timezones for multi-channel users
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Supports city search, location detection, and manual offset
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Messages are scheduled in your local time
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • See Timezone help topic for details

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Signature
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Premium feature — add a signature to your messages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose position (start/end) and blank lines before it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Preview before saving
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • See Signature help topic for details

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Channels
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Each channel can have its own timezone
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Manage connected channels with /channel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Commands
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • See Commands Overview for the full command list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Most features are accessible via both commands and buttons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Language Sync
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Language is shared between @FastSchedulerBot and @SetDate_bot
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Can be disabled entirely in the Language menu
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Anyone can disable sync entirely in the Language menu

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Managing Multiple Channels & Bots
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Connect up to 1 channel (3 on Premium)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Connect up to 1 sender bot (3 on Premium)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Each channel can use a different sender bot
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • See relevant help topics for details

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Where are the settings?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      There is no single Settings button. Each setting is accessible from its own menu or command:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /language — change language
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /timezone — set timezone
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /signature — manage signature (Premium)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /channel — manage channels
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • /commands — list all available commands
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Settings are also available from the main menu buttons.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      LanguageTime ZoneSignatures (Premium)Text CommandsConnecting a Channel
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I use different timezones for different channels?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Yes. Use /timezone and then select a specific channel to set its timezone independently. Each channel's scheduled messages will use its own timezone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Time ZoneMulti-Channel Scheduling

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Add a custom signature — for example "Posted by @yourbot" — to every post on the channels you choose.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How to set up:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1. Tap 📝 Signature on the main menu or send /signature.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2. Use Add Signature and send your signature text (bold, italic, code and links work).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3. Pick the position — start or end of the post — and how many blank lines separate it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        4. Enable auto-add and select the channels it should attach to; or add it per message from the signature list.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Good to know:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Signatures are appended at send time — your stored messages stay clean.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • They never take over your inline button rows.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Free users can try signatures once; after that it is a Premium feature.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        When Premium expires: auto-add stops once Premium is gone, and signature settings are deleted when the expiry process fully completes. Reactivate Premium to keep everything.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How to Add an Automatic Signature to Every Telegram Post

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Settings & Configuration2 Q&A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A signature is the footer that appears under every post in a channel: credit, CTA, hashtags, promo. Set it once in Fast Scheduler and every scheduled message carries it — you stop copy-pasting “@yourchannel” to the end of everything.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Setting it up

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 1. Open Signature via /signature (or tap 📝 Signature on the review screen). Premium feature.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 2. Pick the channel — signatures are per channel, so your main channel can carry a promo while the announcements channel stays clean.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 3. Send the text. Formatting works: bold, italic, links, even emoji-free minimalism if that is your style.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          From the next send onward, the signature is appended to every post in that channel. Existing scheduled posts pick it up automatically at send time — no need to reschedule anything.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What belongs in a good signature

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The channel handle — the classic “@yourchannel” line, since forwarded copies keep the credit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • One action — “Reply to buy”, “Details: link”. A signature with three CTAs has zero.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hashtags for navigation — if the channel uses tag-indexing, the signature is the perfect place for the constant ones.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Changing and removing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The same menu edits or clears the signature; clearing stops appending immediately (again, applied at send time, so posts already published keep their footer — that is a feature, not a bug). Per-channel control means experimenting is cheap.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Common questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can I use different signatures for different channels?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Yes — signatures are configured per channel. Each connected channel gets its own text (or none).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Signatures (Premium)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Does the signature count toward the message length?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          It is part of the final message text, so extremely long signatures can hit Telegram’s 4096-character limit on top of long posts. Short signatures are better anyway.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Signature Position

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          More topics

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Choose where the signature appears in the sent message:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • At the end (default) - classic sign-off under the content.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • At the start - the signature line first, then your content.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          You can also add blank lines before the signature so it is visually separated from the message body. Preview before saving to see the result.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Copying Items Between Boxes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            More topics

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Copy places a duplicate of an item into another box while the original stays where it is — unlike Move, which relocates the item.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            When copying beats moving
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A logo that belongs to several campaign boxes at once.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Seasonal collections that share evergreen assets.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A "favourites" box that mirrors items from working boxes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Copies are independent: editing or deleting one copy never affects the other, and every schedule that references either box keeps working.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Scheduling Time Zone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          More topics

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Every date/time you enter is interpreted in the channel's time zone, not necessarily yours.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Set or check the channel's time zone: Channels → select the channel → Time Zone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If your messages seem to post at the wrong hour, this is almost always the cause - update the time zone and re-schedule.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    More topics

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Move items between your boxes to reorganize your library.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Pick the item → Move → choose the destination box. The media is relocated; schedules referencing it keep working.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      More topics

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Photos in storage can be reused in any scheduled message via From Storage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Photos are compressed on upload (see Media Compression). Free plan stores up to 100 items total across your box.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Schedules that use this media automatically use the new file from then on.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          More topics

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Videos in storage are a Premium feature.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Store videos up to 50MB and reuse them in schedules. Videos are compressed to keep storage reasonable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Free accounts cannot add videos to storage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Scheduling Time Zone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            More topics

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Every date/time you enter is interpreted in the channel's time zone, not necessarily yours.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Set or check the channel's time zone: Channels → select the channel → Time Zone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            If your messages seem to post at the wrong hour, this is almost always the cause - update the time zone and re-schedule.
